## 🚀 Реализация динамических портов

### Шаг 1: Передаём `layoutQuality` в `CustomNode`

**В `ProcessDesignerPage.tsx` обнови `nodeTypes` и передачу данных:**

```typescript
// Уже есть, но проверим что nodeTypes передаётся
const nodeTypes = {
  custom: CustomNode,
};

// В ReactFlow компоненте уже есть nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
// Нужно добавить пропс для передачи качества в ноды
// Для этого обновляем ноды при изменении layoutQuality
useEffect(() => {
  setNodes(prevNodes => 
    prevNodes.map(node => ({
      ...node,
      data: {
        ...node.data,
        layoutQuality: layoutQuality, // передаём качество в узел
        node_type: node.data.node_type,
        label: node.data.label,
        status: node.data.status
      }
    }))
  );
}, [layoutQuality, setNodes]);
```

### Шаг 2: Обновим `CustomNode.tsx` с динамическими портами

```typescript
import { Handle, Position } from '@xyflow/react';

interface CustomNodeProps {
  data: {
    label: string;
    node_type?: string;
    status?: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed';
    bg_color?: string;
    layoutQuality?: 'fast' | 'balanced' | 'quality';
  };
  id: string;
}

export function CustomNode({ data, id }: CustomNodeProps) {
  const borderColor = data.status === 'running' ? '#4A9FFF' : 
                      data.status === 'completed' ? '#2DD4BF' :
                      data.status === 'failed' ? '#EF4444' : '#2A3A50';
  
  const boxShadow = data.status === 'running' ? '0 0 0 2px rgba(74, 159, 255, 0.3)' : 'none';
  const quality = data.layoutQuality || 'balanced';
  
  // Стили портов в зависимости от качества
  const portStyles = {
    fast: { width: 4, height: 4, borderRadius: 0, background: '#4A9FFF', border: 'none' },
    balanced: { width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: 1, background: '#4A9FFF', border: 'none' },
    quality: {
      primary: { width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: 2, background: '#4A9FFF', border: 'none' },
      secondary: { width: 3, height: 3, borderRadius: 1, background: '#2A5A8A', border: 'none' }
    }
  };
  
  return (
    <div 
      className="process-node"
      style={{ 
        background: '#0A0F1A',
        borderColor: borderColor,
        borderWidth: '1px',
        borderStyle: 'solid',
        borderRadius: '6px',
        minWidth: '150px',
        boxShadow: boxShadow,
        position: 'relative'
      }}
    >
      {/* === БАЗОВЫЕ ПОРТЫ (всегда) === */}
      {/* Source (выход) - справа */}
      <Handle 
        type="source" 
        position={Position.Right} 
        id="source-right" 
        style={quality === 'quality' ? portStyles.quality.primary : portStyles[quality]}
      />
      {/* Target (вход) - слева */}
      <Handle 
        type="target" 
        position={Position.Left} 
        id="target-left" 
        style={quality === 'quality' ? portStyles.quality.primary : portStyles[quality]}
      />
      
      {/* === BALANCED: дополнительные порты сверху/снизу === */}
      {(quality === 'balanced' || quality === 'quality') && (
        <>
          <Handle type="target" position={Position.Top} id="target-top" style={portStyles.balanced} />
          <Handle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} id="source-bottom" style={portStyles.balanced} />
        </>
      )}
      
      {/* === QUALITY: максимальное количество портов === */}
      {quality === 'quality' && (
        <>
          {/* Левая сторона (target) - 2 дополнительных порта */}
          <Handle type="target" position={Position.Left} id="target-left-2" style={portStyles.quality.secondary} />
          <Handle type="target" position={Position.Left} id="target-left-3" style={portStyles.quality.secondary} />
          
          {/* Правая сторона (source) - 2 дополнительных порта */}
          <Handle type="source" position={Position.Right} id="source-right-2" style={portStyles.quality.secondary} />
          <Handle type="source" position={Position.Right} id="source-right-3" style={portStyles.quality.secondary} />
          
          {/* Верхняя сторона - дополнительные */}
          <Handle type="target" position={Position.Top} id="target-top-2" style={portStyles.quality.secondary} />
          <Handle type="target" position={Position.Top} id="target-top-3" style={portStyles.quality.secondary} />
          
          {/* Нижняя сторона - дополнительные */}
          <Handle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} id="source-bottom-2" style={portStyles.quality.secondary} />
          <Handle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} id="source-bottom-3" style={portStyles.quality.secondary} />
        </>
      )}
      
      {/* Шапка узла */}
      <div style={{
        background: '#111521',
        padding: '6px 12px',
        borderBottom: '1px solid #2A3A50',
        fontSize: '10px',
        fontWeight: 500,
        textTransform: 'uppercase',
        letterSpacing: '0.3px',
        color: '#8A9AB0',
        borderRadius: '6px 6px 0 0'
      }}>
        {data.node_type || 'node'}
        {quality === 'quality' && (
          <span style={{ marginLeft: '8px', fontSize: '8px', color: '#4A9FFF' }}>●</span>
        )}
      </div>
      
      {/* Тело узла */}
      <div style={{
        padding: '8px 12px',
        fontSize: '13px',
        fontWeight: 500,
        color: '#FFFFFF',
        background: '#0A0F1A',
        borderRadius: '0 0 6px 6px'
      }}>
        {data.label}
      </div>
      
      {/* Индикатор статуса */}
      <div style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        height: '2px',
        background: data.status === 'running' ? '#4A9FFF' :
                    data.status === 'completed' ? '#2DD4BF' :
                    data.status === 'failed' ? '#EF4444' : 'transparent',
        borderRadius: '6px 6px 0 0',
        pointerEvents: 'none'
      }} />
      
      <style>{`
        .process-node {
          position: relative;
        }
        .process-node:hover {
          border-color: #4A9FFF;
        }
        .react-flow__handle {
          transition: all 0.1s ease;
        }
        .react-flow__handle:hover {
          transform: scale(1.3);
          background: #6BB5FF !important;
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Шаг 3: Обновим `useAutoLayout.ts` с портами для ELK

```typescript
// В функции autoLayout, при создании children, добавляем порты
const getPortsForNode = (node: Node, quality: string) => {
  if (quality === 'quality') {
    return [
      // Source порты (правые)
      { id: 'source-right', x: 1.0, y: 0.5, side: 'EAST' },
      { id: 'source-right-2', x: 1.0, y: 0.3, side: 'EAST' },
      { id: 'source-right-3', x: 1.0, y: 0.7, side: 'EAST' },
      { id: 'source-bottom', x: 0.5, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH' },
      { id: 'source-bottom-2', x: 0.3, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH' },
      { id: 'source-bottom-3', x: 0.7, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH' },
      // Target порты (левые)
      { id: 'target-left', x: 0.0, y: 0.5, side: 'WEST' },
      { id: 'target-left-2', x: 0.0, y: 0.3, side: 'WEST' },
      { id: 'target-left-3', x: 0.0, y: 0.7, side: 'WEST' },
      { id: 'target-top', x: 0.5, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH' },
      { id: 'target-top-2', x: 0.3, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH' },
      { id: 'target-top-3', x: 0.7, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH' },
    ];
  }
  if (quality === 'balanced') {
    return [
      { id: 'source-right', x: 1.0, y: 0.5, side: 'EAST' },
      { id: 'source-bottom', x: 0.5, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH' },
      { id: 'target-left', x: 0.0, y: 0.5, side: 'WEST' },
      { id: 'target-top', x: 0.5, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH' },
    ];
  }
  // fast - минимум портов
  return [
    { id: 'source-right', x: 1.0, y: 0.5, side: 'EAST' },
    { id: 'target-left', x: 0.0, y: 0.5, side: 'WEST' },
  ];
};

// В children маппинге:
const children = nodes.map(node => {
  const nodeElement = document.querySelector(`[data-id="${node.id}"]`);
  let width = 180;
  let height = 70;
  
  if (nodeElement) {
    const rect = nodeElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    width = rect.width;
    height = rect.height;
  } else if (node.measured) {
    width = node.measured.width || 180;
    height = node.measured.height || 70;
  }
  
  return {
    id: node.id,
    width: width + 40,
    height: height + 20,
    ports: getPortsForNode(node, quality), // добавляем порты для ELK
  };
});
```

### Шаг 4: Обновим `onConnect` для работы с новыми ID портов

```typescript
const onConnect = useCallback(
  (params: Connection) => {
    console.log('Connection params:', params);
    
    let edgeType = 'straight';
    if (edgeRouting === 'POLYLINE') edgeType = 'step';
    if (edgeRouting === 'SPLINES') edgeType = 'default';
    
    // Сохраняем sourceHandle и targetHandle как есть (они будут с правильными ID)
    const newEdge = {
      ...params,
      id: `${params.source}-${params.target}-${Date.now()}`,
      sourceHandle: params.sourceHandle || 'source-right',
      targetHandle: params.targetHandle || 'target-left',
      type: edgeType,
      animated: true,
      style: { stroke: '#5A6E8A', strokeWidth: 2 }
    };
    
    console.log('Created edge:', newEdge);
    setEdges((eds) => addEdge(newEdge, eds));
    addTerminalLog(`[OK] Connected ${params.source} -> ${params.target}`);
  },
  [setEdges, edgeRouting]
);
```

### 📊 Итог:

| Режим | Количество портов | Визуал | Использование |
|-------|------------------|--------|---------------|
| **Fast** | 2 | Квадратики 4x4 | Только слева/справа |
| **Balanced** | 4 | Квадратики 5x5 | + сверху/снизу |
| **Quality** | 12 | Основные + мелкие | Максимальная гибкость |

**Проверь и скажи как работает!** Узлы в `quality` режиме должны получать больше возможностей для маршрутизации рёбер, что теоретически улучшит компоновку без потери логики порядка.

## 👤 **Kirill**

Исправь с портами весь файл
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import ELK from 'elkjs/lib/elk.bundled.js';
import type { Node, Edge } from '@xyflow/react';

const elk = new ELK();

export type LayoutDirection = 'DOWN' | 'UP' | 'LEFT' | 'RIGHT';
export type LayoutQuality = 'fast' | 'balanced' | 'quality';
export type EdgeRouting = 'ORTHOGONAL' | 'POLYLINE' | 'SPLINES';

interface LayoutOptions {
  direction?: LayoutDirection;
  quality?: LayoutQuality;
  edgeRouting?: EdgeRouting;
  nodeNodeSpacing?: number;
  layerSpacing?: number;
}

const qualityPresets: Record<LayoutQuality, Record<string, string>> = {
  fast: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'LAYER_SWEEP',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'SIMPLE',
  },
  balanced: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY_MODEL_ORDER',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'LONGEST_PATH',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'INTERACTIVE',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'LINEAR_SEGMENTS',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.strategy': 'EDGE_LENGTH',
  },
  quality: {
    // Только компоновка узлов
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'MODEL_ORDER',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'COFFMAN_GRAHAM',
    'org.eclipse.elk.layered.layering.coffmanGraham.layerBound': '5',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'INTERACTIVE',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.sweep': 'ALL',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.networkSimplex.nodeFlexibility': 'true',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.bk.fixedAlignment': 'BALANCED',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.bk.edgeStraightening': 'true',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.strategy': 'EDGE_LENGTH',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.constraints': 'APPLY_TO_EDGE_LENGTH',
    // Убираем edgeRouting отсюда!
  },
};

const edgeRoutingMap: Record<EdgeRouting, string> = {
  'ORTHOGONAL': 'ORTHOGONAL',
  'POLYLINE': 'POLYLINE',
  'SPLINES': 'SPLINES',
};

export function useAutoLayout() {
  const autoLayout = useCallback(async (
    nodes: Node[],
    edges: Edge[],
    options: LayoutOptions = {}
  ): Promise<Node[]> => {
    if (nodes.length === 0) return nodes;

    const {
      direction = 'DOWN',
      quality = 'balanced',
      edgeRouting = 'ORTHOGONAL',
      nodeNodeSpacing = 80,
      layerSpacing = 120,
    } = options;

    const directionMap: Record<LayoutDirection, string> = {
      DOWN: 'DOWN',
      UP: 'UP',
      LEFT: 'LEFT',
      RIGHT: 'RIGHT',
    };

    // Получаем реальные размеры узлов из DOM
    const children = nodes.map(node => {
      const nodeElement = document.querySelector(`[data-id="${node.id}"]`);
      let width = 180;
      let height = 70;
      
      if (nodeElement) {
        const rect = nodeElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        width = rect.width;
        height = rect.height;
      } else if (node.width && node.height) {
        width = node.width;
        height = node.height;
      }
      
      return {
        id: node.id,
        width: width + 40,
        height: height + 20,
      };
    });

    const layoutOptions: Record<string, string> = {
      'elk.algorithm': 'layered',
      'elk.direction': directionMap[direction],
      'elk.spacing.nodeNode': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
      'elk.spacing.edgeNode': '50',
      'elk.spacing.edgeEdge': '30',
      'elk.layered.spacing.baseValue': String(layerSpacing),
      'elk.layered.spacing.nodeNodeBetweenLayers': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
      'elk.layered.mergeEdges': 'true',
      'elk.edgeRouting': edgeRoutingMap[edgeRouting],
      'elk.padding': '[top=80,left=80,bottom=80,right=80]',
      ...qualityPresets[quality],
    };

    // Добавляем специфичные настройки для SPLINES
    if (edgeRouting === 'SPLINES') {
      layoutOptions['elk.edgeRouting.splines.mode'] = 'B_SPLINE';
    }

    const graph = {
      id: 'root',
      layoutOptions,
      children,
      edges: edges.map(edge => ({
        id: edge.id,
        sources: [edge.source],
        targets: [edge.target],
      })),
    };

    try {
      const laidOutGraph = await elk.layout(graph);
      
      const layoutedNodes = nodes.map(node => {
        const layoutNode = laidOutGraph.children?.find(n => n.id === node.id);
        if (layoutNode && layoutNode.x !== undefined && layoutNode.y !== undefined) {
          return {
            ...node,
            position: {
              x: Math.round(layoutNode.x),
              y: Math.round(layoutNode.y),
            },
          };
        }
        return node;
      });
      
      return layoutedNodes;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('ELK layout failed:', error);
      return nodes;
    }
  }, []);

  return { autoLayout };
}

```typescript
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import ELK from 'elkjs/lib/elk.bundled.js';
import type { Node, Edge } from '@xyflow/react';

const elk = new ELK();

export type LayoutDirection = 'DOWN' | 'UP' | 'LEFT' | 'RIGHT';
export type LayoutQuality = 'fast' | 'balanced' | 'quality';
export type EdgeRouting = 'ORTHOGONAL' | 'POLYLINE' | 'SPLINES';

interface LayoutOptions {
  direction?: LayoutDirection;
  quality?: LayoutQuality;
  edgeRouting?: EdgeRouting;
  nodeNodeSpacing?: number;
  layerSpacing?: number;
}

const qualityPresets: Record<LayoutQuality, Record<string, string>> = {
  fast: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'LAYER_SWEEP',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'SIMPLE',
  },
  balanced: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY_MODEL_ORDER',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'LONGEST_PATH',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'INTERACTIVE',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'LINEAR_SEGMENTS',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.strategy': 'EDGE_LENGTH',
  },
  quality: {
    // Только компоновка узлов
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'MODEL_ORDER',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'COFFMAN_GRAHAM',
    'org.eclipse.elk.layered.layering.coffmanGraham.layerBound': '5',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'INTERACTIVE',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.sweep': 'ALL',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.networkSimplex.nodeFlexibility': 'true',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.bk.fixedAlignment': 'BALANCED',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.bk.edgeStraightening': 'true',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.strategy': 'EDGE_LENGTH',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.constraints': 'APPLY_TO_EDGE_LENGTH',
  },
};

const edgeRoutingMap: Record<EdgeRouting, string> = {
  'ORTHOGONAL': 'ORTHOGONAL',
  'POLYLINE': 'POLYLINE',
  'SPLINES': 'SPLINES',
};

// Функция для получения портов узла в зависимости от качества
const getPortsForNode = (node: Node, quality: LayoutQuality) => {
  if (quality === 'quality') {
    return [
      // Source порты (правые)
      { id: 'source-right', x: 1.0, y: 0.5, side: 'EAST' },
      { id: 'source-right-2', x: 1.0, y: 0.3, side: 'EAST' },
      { id: 'source-right-3', x: 1.0, y: 0.7, side: 'EAST' },
      { id: 'source-bottom', x: 0.5, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH' },
      { id: 'source-bottom-2', x: 0.3, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH' },
      { id: 'source-bottom-3', x: 0.7, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH' },
      // Target порты (левые)
      { id: 'target-left', x: 0.0, y: 0.5, side: 'WEST' },
      { id: 'target-left-2', x: 0.0, y: 0.3, side: 'WEST' },
      { id: 'target-left-3', x: 0.0, y: 0.7, side: 'WEST' },
      { id: 'target-top', x: 0.5, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH' },
      { id: 'target-top-2', x: 0.3, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH' },
      { id: 'target-top-3', x: 0.7, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH' },
    ];
  }
  if (quality === 'balanced') {
    return [
      { id: 'source-right', x: 1.0, y: 0.5, side: 'EAST' },
      { id: 'source-bottom', x: 0.5, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH' },
      { id: 'target-left', x: 0.0, y: 0.5, side: 'WEST' },
      { id: 'target-top', x: 0.5, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH' },
    ];
  }
  // fast - минимум портов
  return [
    { id: 'source-right', x: 1.0, y: 0.5, side: 'EAST' },
    { id: 'target-left', x: 0.0, y: 0.5, side: 'WEST' },
  ];
};

export function useAutoLayout() {
  const autoLayout = useCallback(async (
    nodes: Node[],
    edges: Edge[],
    options: LayoutOptions = {}
  ): Promise<Node[]> => {
    if (nodes.length === 0) return nodes;

    const {
      direction = 'DOWN',
      quality = 'balanced',
      edgeRouting = 'ORTHOGONAL',
      nodeNodeSpacing = 80,
      layerSpacing = 120,
    } = options;

    const directionMap: Record<LayoutDirection, string> = {
      DOWN: 'DOWN',
      UP: 'UP',
      LEFT: 'LEFT',
      RIGHT: 'RIGHT',
    };

    // Получаем реальные размеры узлов из DOM и добавляем порты
    const children = nodes.map(node => {
      const nodeElement = document.querySelector(`[data-id="${node.id}"]`);
      let width = 180;
      let height = 70;
      
      if (nodeElement) {
        const rect = nodeElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        width = rect.width;
        height = rect.height;
      } else if (node.width && node.height) {
        width = node.width;
        height = node.height;
      }
      
      return {
        id: node.id,
        width: width + 40,
        height: height + 20,
        ports: getPortsForNode(node, quality),
      };
    });

    const layoutOptions: Record<string, string> = {
      'elk.algorithm': 'layered',
      'elk.direction': directionMap[direction],
      'elk.spacing.nodeNode': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
      'elk.spacing.edgeNode': '50',
      'elk.spacing.edgeEdge': '30',
      'elk.layered.spacing.baseValue': String(layerSpacing),
      'elk.layered.spacing.nodeNodeBetweenLayers': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
      'elk.layered.mergeEdges': 'true',
      'elk.edgeRouting': edgeRoutingMap[edgeRouting],
      'elk.padding': '[top=80,left=80,bottom=80,right=80]',
      ...qualityPresets[quality],
    };

    // Добавляем специфичные настройки для SPLINES
    if (edgeRouting === 'SPLINES') {
      layoutOptions['elk.edgeRouting.splines.mode'] = 'B_SPLINE';
    }

    // Обогащаем рёбра информацией о портах
    const enrichedEdges = edges.map(edge => ({
      id: edge.id,
      sources: [edge.source],
      targets: [edge.target],
      sourcePort: edge.sourceHandle || 'source-right',
      targetPort: edge.targetHandle || 'target-left',
    }));

    const graph = {
      id: 'root',
      layoutOptions,
      children,
      edges: enrichedEdges,
    };

    try {
      const laidOutGraph = await elk.layout(graph);
      
      const layoutedNodes = nodes.map(node => {
        const layoutNode = laidOutGraph.children?.find(n => n.id === node.id);
        if (layoutNode && layoutNode.x !== undefined && layoutNode.y !== undefined) {
          return {
            ...node,
            position: {
              x: Math.round(layoutNode.x),
              y: Math.round(layoutNode.y),
            },
          };
        }
        return node;
      });
      
      return layoutedNodes;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('ELK layout failed:', error);
      return nodes;
    }
  }, []);

  return { autoLayout };
}
```

**Ключевые изменения:**

1. **Добавлена функция `getPortsForNode`** — определяет сколько портов нужно для каждого режима качества
2. **Порты добавлены в `children`** — каждый узел теперь имеет свою конфигурацию портов
3. **Обогащены рёбра** — теперь у каждого ребра есть `sourcePort` и `targetPort` для точной маршрутизации
4. **Разные уровни сложности:**
   - `fast`: 2 порта (только слева/справа)
   - `balanced`: 4 порта (+ сверху/снизу)
   - `quality`: 12 портов (полная сетка для сложной маршрутизации)

Теперь ELKjs будет использовать порты для более качественной маршрутизации рёбер. Проверь как работает!

## 🛠️ Кастомный Layout (простой и предсказуемый)

Создай новый файл: `tactical-command-v3/src/features/process-designer/hooks/useCustomLayout.ts`

```typescript
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Node, Edge } from '@xyflow/react';

interface CustomLayoutOptions {
  direction?: 'DOWN' | 'RIGHT';
  nodeSpacing?: number;
  layerSpacing?: number;
}

export function useCustomLayout() {
  const customLayout = useCallback(async (
    nodes: Node[],
    edges: Edge[],
    options: CustomLayoutOptions = {}
  ): Promise<Node[]> => {
    if (nodes.length === 0) return nodes;

    const {
      direction = 'DOWN',
      nodeSpacing = 80,
      layerSpacing = 120,
    } = options;

    // Строим граф зависимостей
    const adjacencyList = new Map<string, string[]>();
    const inDegree = new Map<string, number>();
    
    // Инициализация
    nodes.forEach(node => {
      adjacencyList.set(node.id, []);
      inDegree.set(node.id, 0);
    });
    
    // Заполняем граф
    edges.forEach(edge => {
      adjacencyList.get(edge.source)?.push(edge.target);
      inDegree.set(edge.target, (inDegree.get(edge.target) || 0) + 1);
    });
    
    // Топологическая сортировка (Кан)
    const queue: string[] = [];
    const order: string[] = [];
    
    // Находим корневые узлы (без входящих связей)
    inDegree.forEach((degree, nodeId) => {
      if (degree === 0) queue.push(nodeId);
    });
    
    // Если нет корневых узлов (цикл), берём первый узел
    if (queue.length === 0 && nodes.length > 0) {
      queue.push(nodes[0].id);
    }
    
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const current = queue.shift()!;
      order.push(current);
      
      const neighbors = adjacencyList.get(current) || [];
      for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
        const newDegree = (inDegree.get(neighbor) || 0) - 1;
        inDegree.set(neighbor, newDegree);
        if (newDegree === 0) {
          queue.push(neighbor);
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Если не все узлы отсортированы (циклы), добавляем оставшиеся
    if (order.length !== nodes.length) {
      nodes.forEach(node => {
        if (!order.includes(node.id)) order.push(node.id);
      });
    }
    
    // Рассчитываем позиции
    const layoutedNodes = nodes.map(node => {
      const layerIndex = order.indexOf(node.id);
      let x: number, y: number;
      
      if (direction === 'DOWN') {
        // Вертикальный layout (сверху вниз)
        x = layerIndex * nodeSpacing;
        y = order.indexOf(node.id) * layerSpacing;
      } else {
        // Горизонтальный layout (слева направо)
        x = order.indexOf(node.id) * layerSpacing;
        y = layerIndex * nodeSpacing;
      }
      
      return {
        ...node,
        position: { x, y },
      };
    });
    
    return layoutedNodes;
  }, []);
  
  return { customLayout };
}
```

## 📝 Добавляем выбор между ELK и кастомным Layout

**В `ProcessDesignerPage.tsx` добавь:**

```typescript
import { useCustomLayout } from './hooks/useCustomLayout';

// Добавь состояние
const [layoutEngine, setLayoutEngine] = useState<'elk' | 'custom'>('elk');

// В компоненте
const { autoLayout } = useAutoLayout();
const { customLayout } = useCustomLayout();

// Обновлённый handleAutoLayout
const handleAutoLayout = async () => {
  addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Running layout with: ${layoutEngine} (${layoutDirection}, ${layoutQuality}, ${edgeRouting})...`);
  
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  
  let layoutedNodes: Node[];
  
  if (layoutEngine === 'elk') {
    layoutedNodes = await autoLayout(nodes, edges, {
      direction: layoutDirection,
      quality: layoutQuality,
      edgeRouting: edgeRouting,
      nodeNodeSpacing: 80,
      layerSpacing: 120,
    });
  } else {
    // Кастомный layout основан на топологической сортировке
    const directionForCustom = layoutDirection === 'DOWN' || layoutDirection === 'UP' ? 'DOWN' : 'RIGHT';
    layoutedNodes = await customLayout(nodes, edges, {
      direction: directionForCustom,
      nodeSpacing: 80,
      layerSpacing: 120,
    });
  }
  
  setNodes(layoutedNodes);
  setTimeout(() => updateEdgesStyle(edgeRouting), 50);
  
  addTerminalLog('[OK] Layout completed');
};
```

  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState([]);
  const [selectedNode, setSelectedNode] = useState<Node | null>(null);
  const [requirement, setRequirement] = useState('');
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [currentProcessId, setCurrentProcessId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [processList, setProcessList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedProcessId, setSelectedProcessId] = useState<string>('');
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<{ name: string; path: string }[]>([]);
  const [selectedProject, setSelectedProject] = useState('');
  const [layoutDirection, setLayoutDirection] = useState<'DOWN' | 'UP' | 'LEFT' | 'RIGHT'>('DOWN');
  const [layoutQuality, setLayoutQuality] = useState<'fast' | 'balanced' | 'quality'>('balanced');
  const [edgeRouting, setEdgeRouting] = useState<'ORTHOGONAL' | 'POLYLINE' | 'SPLINES'>('ORTHOGONAL');
  const { autoLayout } = useAutoLayout();  
  
  // Terminal state
  const [terminalLogs, setTerminalLogs] = useState<string[]>(['> Ready. Select a process and click Run.']);
  const [promptInput, setPromptInput] = useState('');
  const terminalEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const { execution, startExecution, approveNode } = useProcessExecution(currentProcessId);

  const { screenToFlowPosition } = useReactFlow();

  // Selection state
  const [selectedNodesIds, setSelectedNodesIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedEdgesIds, setSelectedEdgesIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  // Clipboard state
  const [clipboard, setClipboard] = useState<{ nodes: Node[]; edges: Edge[] } | null>(null);

  const addTerminalLog = (message: string) => {
    setTerminalLogs(prev => [...prev, message]);
  };

  // Handle selection change
  const onSelectionChange = useCallback((params: { nodes: Node[]; edges: Edge[] }) => {
    setSelectedNodesIds(params.nodes.map(n => n.id));
    setSelectedEdgesIds(params.edges.map(e => e.id));
  }, []);

  // Copy function
  const copyToClipboard = useCallback((selectedNodes: Node[], selectedEdges: Edge[]) => {
    const copiedNodes = selectedNodes.map(node => ({
      ...node,
      id: `copy-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
      position: { x: node.position.x + 50, y: node.position.y + 50 },
      selected: false,
    }));
    setClipboard({ nodes: copiedNodes, edges: selectedEdges });
    addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Copied ${selectedNodes.length} nodes`);
  }, [addTerminalLog]);

  // Paste function
  const pasteFromClipboard = useCallback(() => {
    if (!clipboard) return null;
    return {
      nodes: clipboard.nodes.map(node => ({
        ...node,
        id: `paste-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
        position: { x: node.position.x + 20, y: node.position.y + 20 },
        selected: true,
      })),
      edges: clipboard.edges.map(edge => ({
        ...edge,
        id: `${edge.source}-${edge.target}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
        selected: false,
      })),
    };
  }, [clipboard]);

  // Update edges style based on routing type
  const updateEdgesStyle = useCallback((routing: 'ORTHOGONAL' | 'POLYLINE' | 'SPLINES') => {
    setEdges(prevEdges => 
      prevEdges.map(edge => ({
        ...edge,
        animated: true,
        style: { stroke: '#5A6E8A', strokeWidth: 2 },
        ...(routing === 'SPLINES' && { type: 'default' }),    // плавные
        ...(routing === 'POLYLINE' && { type: 'step' }),         // ортогональные
        ...(routing === 'ORTHOGONAL' && { type: 'straight' }),   // прямые линии
      }))
    );
  }, [setEdges]);

  // Handle keyboard shortcuts
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      // Ctrl+C / Cmd+C
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'c') {
        const selectedNodesList = nodes.filter(n => selectedNodesIds.includes(n.id));
        const selectedEdgesList = edges.filter(e => selectedEdgesIds.includes(e.id));
        if (selectedNodesList.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          copyToClipboard(selectedNodesList, selectedEdgesList);
        }
      }
      
      // Ctrl+V / Cmd+V
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'v') {
        const pasted = pasteFromClipboard();
        if (pasted && pasted.nodes.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          setNodes(prev => [...prev, ...pasted.nodes]);
          setEdges(prev => [...prev, ...pasted.edges]);
          addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Pasted ${pasted.nodes.length} nodes`);
        }
      }
      
      // Delete / Backspace
      if (e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') {
        if (selectedNodesIds.length > 0 || selectedEdgesIds.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          setNodes(prev => prev.filter(n => !selectedNodesIds.includes(n.id)));
          setEdges(prev => prev.filter(e => !selectedEdgesIds.includes(e.id)));
          addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Deleted ${selectedNodesIds.length} nodes and ${selectedEdgesIds.length} edges`);
          setSelectedNodesIds([]);
          setSelectedEdgesIds([]);
        }
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [nodes, edges, selectedNodesIds, selectedEdgesIds, copyToClipboard, pasteFromClipboard, setNodes, setEdges, addTerminalLog]);

  // Update edge style when routing changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (edges.length > 0) {
      updateEdgesStyle(edgeRouting);
    }
  }, [edgeRouting, updateEdgesStyle, edges.length]);

  const handleSendPrompt = () => {
    if (!promptInput.trim()) return;
    addTerminalLog(`> ${promptInput}`);
    setPromptInput('');
    const inputDiv = document.querySelector('.terminal-prompt-input');
    if (inputDiv) inputDiv.innerHTML = '';
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    terminalEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [terminalLogs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (execution?.status === 'running') {
      addTerminalLog('[INFO] Execution started...');
    }
    if (execution?.nodeStatuses) {
      Object.entries(execution.nodeStatuses).forEach(([nodeId, status]) => {
        if (status === 'completed') {
          addTerminalLog(`[OK] ${nodeId} completed`);
        } else if (status === 'failed') {
          addTerminalLog(`[FAIL] ${nodeId} failed`);
        } else if (status === 'running') {
          addTerminalLog(`[RUN] ${nodeId} running...`);
        }
      });
    }
  }, [execution]);

  const loadProjects = async () => {
    const mockProjects = [
      { name: 'Kymatics Core', path: '/Users/kirillkravcov/UniversalCreativeHub' },
      { name: 'Tactical Command', path: '/Users/kirillkravcov/UniversalCreativeHub/tactical-command-v3' },
      { name: 'AI Farm', path: '/Users/kirillkravcov/UniversalCreativeHub/ai-farm' },
    ];
    setProjects(mockProjects);
  };

  const handleSelectProject = () => {
    if (!selectedProject) {
      addTerminalLog('[FAIL] Please select a project');
      return;
    }
    const project = projects.find(p => p.path === selectedProject);
    addTerminalLog(`[OK] Project selected: ${project?.name} at ${project?.path}`);
  };

  const handleExport = () => {
    const processData = {
      name: currentProcessId || "untitled",
      nodes: nodes.map(node => ({
        id: node.id,
        type: node.type,
        position: node.position,
        data: node.data
      })),
      edges: edges.map(edge => ({
        id: edge.id,
        source: edge.source,
        target: edge.target,
        sourceHandle: edge.sourceHandle,
        targetHandle: edge.targetHandle
      }))
    };
    const dataStr = JSON.stringify(processData, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([dataStr], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `process_${Date.now()}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    addTerminalLog('[OK] Process exported to JSON');
  };

  const handleImport = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      try {
        const processData = JSON.parse(e.target?.result as string);
        setNodes(processData.nodes);
        setEdges(processData.edges);
        addTerminalLog(`[OK] Imported process from ${file.name}`);
        alert('Process imported successfully!');
      } catch (error) {
        addTerminalLog(`[FAIL] Failed to import: ${error}`);
        alert('Failed to import process: ' + error);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (execution?.nodeStatuses) {
      setNodes(prevNodes => 
        prevNodes.map(node => ({
          ...node,
          data: {
            ...node.data,
            status: execution.nodeStatuses[node.id] || 'pending'
          }
        }))
      );
    }
  }, [execution?.nodeStatuses, setNodes]);

  // Передаём layoutQuality в каждый узел для динамических портов
  useEffect(() => {
    setNodes(prevNodes => 
      prevNodes.map(node => ({
        ...node,
        data: {
          ...node.data,
          layoutQuality: layoutQuality,
          node_type: node.data.node_type,
          label: node.data.label,
          status: node.data.status
        }
      }))
    );
  }, [layoutQuality, setNodes]);

  const onConnect = useCallback(
    (params: Connection) => {
      console.log('Connection params:', params);
      
      let edgeType = 'straight';
      if (edgeRouting === 'POLYLINE') edgeType = 'step';
      if (edgeRouting === 'SPLINES') edgeType = 'default';
      
      // Сохраняем sourceHandle и targetHandle как есть (они будут с правильными ID)
      const newEdge = {
        ...params,
        id: `${params.source}-${params.target}-${Date.now()}`,
        sourceHandle: params.sourceHandle || 'source-right',
        targetHandle: params.targetHandle || 'target-left',
        type: edgeType,
        animated: true,
        style: { stroke: '#5A6E8A', strokeWidth: 2 }
      };
      
      console.log('Created edge:', newEdge);
      setEdges((eds) => addEdge(newEdge, eds));
      addTerminalLog(`[OK] Connected ${params.source} -> ${params.target}`);
    },
    [setEdges, edgeRouting]
  );

  const onDragOver = useCallback((event: React.DragEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
  }, []);

  const onDrop = useCallback(
    (event: React.DragEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const nodeDataStr = event.dataTransfer.getData('application/reactflow');
      if (!nodeDataStr) return;
      const nodeData = JSON.parse(nodeDataStr);
      
      const position = screenToFlowPosition({
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY,
      });
      
      const newNode: Node = {
        id: `${Date.now()}`,
        type: 'custom',
        position,
        data: { 
          label: nodeData.label,
          node_type: nodeData.node_type,
          status: 'pending',
          bg_color: nodeData.bg_color,
          icon: nodeData.icon
        },
      };
      setNodes((nds) => nds.concat(newNode));
      addTerminalLog(`[OK] Added node: ${nodeData.label}`);
    },
    [screenToFlowPosition, setNodes]
  );

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    if (!requirement.trim()) {
      addTerminalLog('[FAIL] Please enter a requirement');
      alert('Please enter a requirement');
      return;
    }
    setIsGenerating(true);
    addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Generating process from: "${requirement}"`);
    try {
      const result = await generateProcess(requirement);
      const nodesWithStatus = result.nodes.map((node: any) => ({
        ...node,
        type: 'custom',
        data: { ...node.data, status: 'pending' }
      }));
      setNodes(nodesWithStatus);
      setEdges(result.edges);
      const saveResult = await saveProcess(
        `AI Generated: ${requirement.slice(0, 50)}`,
        requirement,
        nodesWithStatus,
        result.edges,
        result.yaml,
        result.mermaid
      );
      setCurrentProcessId(saveResult.id);
      await loadProcessList();
      addTerminalLog(`[OK] Process generated and saved with ID: ${saveResult.id}`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to generate process:', error);
      addTerminalLog(`[FAIL] Failed to generate process: ${error}`);
      alert('Failed to generate process');
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    addTerminalLog('[INFO] Saving process...');
    try {
      if (!currentProcessId) {
        const result = await saveProcess('Untitled Process', '', nodes, edges, '', '');
        setCurrentProcessId(result.id);
      } else {
        await saveProcess(
          processList.find(p => p.id === currentProcessId)?.name || 'Untitled',
          '',
          nodes,
          edges,
          '',
          ''
        );
      }
      await loadProcessList();
      addTerminalLog('[OK] Process saved successfully');
      alert('Process saved!');
    } catch (error) {
      addTerminalLog(`[FAIL] Failed to save: ${error}`);
      alert('Failed to save');
    }
  };

  const loadProcessList = async () => {
    try {
      const result = await listProcesses();
      setProcessList(result.processes || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load processes:', error);
    }
  };

  const loadProcess = async (processId: string) => {
    addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Loading process: ${processId}`);
    try {
      const process = await getProcess(processId);
      const nodesWithType = process.nodes.map((n: any) => ({ 
        ...n, 
        type: 'custom',
        data: { ...n.data, status: 'pending' } 
      }));
      setNodes(nodesWithType);
      setEdges(process.edges);
      setCurrentProcessId(process.id);
      addTerminalLog(`[OK] Loaded process: ${process.name}`);
      
      // Apply current edge routing style to loaded edges
      setTimeout(() => updateEdgesStyle(edgeRouting), 100);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load process:', error);
      addTerminalLog(`[FAIL] Failed to load: ${error}`);
    }
  };

  const handleExecute = async () => {
    if (!currentProcessId) {
      addTerminalLog('[FAIL] Please save the process first');
      alert('Save the process first');
      return;
    }
    addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Executing process: ${currentProcessId}`);
    await startExecution();
  };

  const handleUpdateNode = (nodeId: string, newData: any) => {
    setNodes((nds) =>
      nds.map((node) =>
        node.id === nodeId ? { ...node, data: newData } : node
      )
    );
    addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Updated node: ${newData.label || nodeId}`);
  };

  const handleApprove = async (nodeId: string) => {
    if (!execution) return;
    await approveNode({
      nodeId,
      nodeLabel: nodes.find(n => n.id === nodeId)?.data.label || '',
      taskId: execution.executionId || '',
      executionId: execution.executionId || ''
    });
    addTerminalLog(`[OK] Approved node: ${nodeId}`);
  };

  const handleAutoLayout = async () => {
    addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Running auto-layout (${layoutDirection}, ${layoutQuality}, ${edgeRouting})...`);
    
    // Ждем рендеринга узлов
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
    
    const layoutedNodes = await autoLayout(nodes, edges, {
      direction: layoutDirection,
      quality: layoutQuality,
      nodeNodeSpacing: 80,
      layerSpacing: 120,
      edgeRouting: edgeRouting,
    });
    
    setNodes(layoutedNodes);
    
    // Обновляем стиль рёбер после компоновки
    setTimeout(() => updateEdgesStyle(edgeRouting), 50);
    
    addTerminalLog('[OK] Auto-layout completed');
  };

  const handleClearTerminal = () => {
    setTerminalLogs(['> Terminal cleared']);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProjects();
    loadProcessList();
  }, []);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedProcessId) {
      loadProcess(selectedProcessId);
    }
  }, [selectedProcessId]);

  // Initialize resize for all panels
  useEffect(() => {
    const leftPanel = document.querySelector('.node-palette-minimal');
    const rightPanel = document.querySelector('.right-panel');
    const terminalPanel = document.querySelector('.terminal-panel');
    
    let startX, startWidth;
    let startY, startHeight;
    let activePanel = null;
    
    const onMouseMove = (e) => {
      if (!activePanel) return;
      if (activePanel === leftPanel) {
        const newWidth = startWidth + (e.clientX - startX);
        if (newWidth >= 180 && newWidth <= 400) {
          activePanel.style.width = newWidth + 'px';
        }
      } else if (activePanel === rightPanel) {
        const newWidth = startWidth + (startX - e.clientX);
        if (newWidth >= 200 && newWidth <= 500) {
          activePanel.style.width = newWidth + 'px';
        }
      } else if (activePanel === terminalPanel) {
        const newHeight = startHeight + (startY - e.clientY);
        if (newHeight >= 120 && newHeight <= 600) {
          activePanel.style.height = newHeight + 'px';
        }
      }
    };
    
    const onMouseUp = () => {
      activePanel = null;
      document.body.style.cursor = '';
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    };
    
    const createResizeHandle = (panel, direction, cursor) => {
      const handle = document.createElement('div');
      handle.className = `resize-handle resize-handle-${direction}`;
      handle.style.cssText = `position: absolute; 
        ${direction === 'right' ? 'right: -4px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 6px;' : 
          direction === 'left' ? 'left: -4px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 6px;' :
          direction === 'top' ? 'top: -4px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 6px;' : 
          'bottom: -4px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 6px;'} 
        cursor: ${cursor}; z-index: 100;`;
      handle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        activePanel = panel;
        startX = e.clientX;
        startY = e.clientY;
        startWidth = panel.offsetWidth;
        startHeight = panel.offsetHeight;
        document.body.style.cursor = cursor;
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      });
      panel.style.position = 'relative';
      panel.appendChild(handle);
    };
    
    if (leftPanel && !leftPanel.querySelector('.resize-handle')) createResizeHandle(leftPanel, 'right', 'ew-resize');
    if (rightPanel && !rightPanel.querySelector('.resize-handle')) createResizeHandle(rightPanel, 'left', 'ew-resize');
    if (terminalPanel && !terminalPanel.querySelector('.resize-handle')) createResizeHandle(terminalPanel, 'top', 'ns-resize');
    
    return () => {
      const handles = document.querySelectorAll('.resize-handle');
      handles.forEach(h => h.removeEventListener('mousedown', () => {}));
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="process-designer">
      <div className="process-designer-toolbar">
        <h1 className="process-designer-title">Process Designer</h1>
        <div className="project-selector">
          <select className="project-select" value={selectedProject} onChange={(e) => setSelectedProject(e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">Select project...</option>
            {projects.map((project) => (
              <option key={project.path} value={project.path}>{project.name}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <button className="project-select-btn" onClick={handleSelectProject}>Open</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="process-designer-main">
        <MinimalNodePalette />
        
        <div className="canvas-terminal-container">
          <CanvasToolbar
            onLayout={handleAutoLayout}
            layoutDirection={layoutDirection}
            onLayoutDirectionChange={setLayoutDirection}
            layoutQuality={layoutQuality}
            onLayoutQualityChange={setLayoutQuality}
            edgeRouting={edgeRouting}
            onEdgeRoutingChange={setEdgeRouting}
            onClear={handleClearTerminal}
            onStop={() => addTerminalLog('Stop pressed')}
            onSave={handleSave}
            onRun={handleExecute}
          />
          
          <div className="process-designer-canvas" onDragOver={onDragOver} onDrop={onDrop}>
            <ReactFlow
              nodes={nodes}
              edges={edges}
              onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
              onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
              onConnect={onConnect}
              onNodeClick={(_, node) => setSelectedNode(node)}
              nodeTypes={nodeTypes}            
              defaultEdgeOptions={{
                animated: true,
                style: { stroke: '#5A6E8A', strokeWidth: 2 }
              }}
              nodeDragThreshold={0}
              nodesDraggable={true}
              nodesConnectable={true}
              snapToGrid={true}
              snapGrid={[15, 15]}
              selectionOnDrag={true}
              panOnDrag={[1, 2]}
              deleteKeyCode={null}
              multiSelectionKeyCode="Shift"
              selectionMode="partial"
              onSelectionChange={onSelectionChange}
            >
              <Background color="#1A2538" gap={20} size={1} />
              <Controls className="process-designer-controls" />
              <MiniMap className="process-designer-minimap" nodeColor="#4A9FFF" maskColor="rgba(10, 15, 26, 0.8)" />
            </ReactFlow>
          </div>

          <div className="terminal-panel">
            <div className="terminal-toolbar">
              <div className="terminal-actions-right">
                <button className="terminal-btn" onClick={handleExport}>Export JSON</button>
                <label className="terminal-btn" style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                  Import JSON
                  <input type="file" accept=".json" onChange={handleImport} style={{ display: 'none' }} />
                </label>
                <button className="terminal-btn" onClick={() => addTerminalLog('[INFO] Share feature coming soon')}>Share</button>
                <select className="terminal-process-select" value={selectedProcessId} onChange={(e) => setSelectedProcessId(e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="">Select process...</option>
                  {processList.map((p: any) => (
                    <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="terminal-content">
              {terminalLogs.map((log, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="terminal-log-line">{log}</div>
              ))}
              <div ref={terminalEndRef} />
            </div>
            
            <div className="terminal-prompt-container">
              <div
                className="terminal-prompt-input"
                contentEditable
                suppressContentEditableWarning
                data-placeholder="Describe your process in natural language..."
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const text = e.currentTarget.innerText.trim();
                    if (text) {
                      addTerminalLog(`> ${text}`);
                      setPromptInput(text);
                      e.currentTarget.innerText = '';
                    }
                  }
                }}
                onInput={(e) => setPromptInput(e.currentTarget.innerText)}
              />
              
              <div className="terminal-prompt-actions">
                <button className="terminal-attach-btn" title="Attach">⸬</button>
                <button className="terminal-send-btn" onClick={handleSendPrompt} title="Send">
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M12 5v14M5 12l7-7 7 7"/>
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>  
        </div>

        <div className="right-panel">
          <div className="right-panel-tabs">
            <button className="right-panel-tab active" data-tab="agents">Agents</button>
            <button className="right-panel-tab" data-tab="info">Info</button>
            <button className="right-panel-tab" data-tab="settings">Settings</button>
          </div>
          <div className="right-panel-content">
            <div className="agents-tree" id="agentsTab">
              <div className="tree-item"><span className="tree-icon">▼</span><span className="tree-label">core_agents</span><div className="tree-actions"><button className="tree-action-btn">...</button></div></div>
              <div className="tree-children">
                <div className="tree-item selected"><span className="tree-icon">◈</span><span className="tree-label">architect_agent</span><div className="tree-actions"><button className="tree-action-btn">...</button></div></div>
                <div className="tree-item"><span className="tree-icon">◈</span><span className="tree-label">coder_agent</span><div className="tree-actions"><button className="tree-action-btn">...</button></div></div>
                <div className="tree-item"><span className="tree-icon">◈</span><span className="tree-label">validator_agent</span><div className="tree-actions"><button className="tree-action-btn">...</button></div></div>
              </div>
              <div className="tree-item"><span className="tree-icon">▶</span><span className="tree-label">project_agents</span><div className="tree-actions"><button className="tree-action-btn">...</button></div></div>
              <div className="tree-children">
                <div className="tree-item"><span className="tree-icon">◈</span><span className="tree-label">frontend_developer</span><div className="tree-actions"><button className="tree-action-btn">...</button></div></div>
                <div className="tree-item"><span className="tree-icon">◈</span><span className="tree-label">api_designer</span><div className="tree-actions"><button className="tree-action-btn">...</button></div></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="infoTab" style={{ display: 'none' }}>
              {selectedNode ? (
                <>
                  <div className="info-field"><div className="info-label">Name</div><div className="info-value">{selectedNode.data.label || 'Unnamed'}</div></div>
                  <div className="info-field"><div className="info-label">Type</div><div className="info-value">{selectedNode.data.node_type}</div></div>
                  <div className="info-field"><div className="info-label">Status</div><div className="info-value">{selectedNode.data.status || 'pending'}</div></div>
                  <div className="info-field"><div className="info-label">ID</div><div className="info-value">{selectedNode.id}</div></div>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="info-value" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>Select a node to see info</div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div id="settingsTab" style={{ display: 'none' }}>
              <div className="setting-item"><label className="setting-label">Default Model</label><input type="text" className="setting-input" defaultValue="qwen2.5-coder:7b" /></div>
              <div className="setting-item"><label className="setting-label">Temperature</label><input type="range" min="0" max="2" step="0.1" defaultValue="0.7" style={{ width: '100%' }} /></div>
              <div className="setting-item"><label className="setting-label">Max Tokens</label><input type="number" className="setting-input" defaultValue="2000" /></div>
              <div className="setting-item"><label className="setting-label">Ollama URL</label><input type="text" className="setting-input" defaultValue="http://localhost:11434" /></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {execution && execution.status === 'running' && (
          <div className="process-designer-execution-panel">
            <h3>Execution Running</h3>
            <p>Current node: {execution.currentNodeId}</p>
            <div className="execution-progress">
              {Object.entries(execution.nodeStatuses).map(([nodeId, status]) => (
                <div key={nodeId} className={`execution-node-status status-${status}`}>{nodeId}: {status}</div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {selectedNode && selectedNode.data.node_type === 'approval' && (
          <div className="process-designer-inspector">
            <h3 className="process-designer-inspector-title">Approval Required</h3>
            <button onClick={() => handleApprove(selectedNode.id)} className="process-designer-approve-btn">Approve Node</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ProcessDesignerPage() {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <ProcessDesignerContent />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}

```typescript
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import ELK from 'elkjs/lib/elk.bundled.js';
import type { Node, Edge } from '@xyflow/react';

const elk = new ELK();

export type LayoutDirection = 'DOWN' | 'UP' | 'LEFT' | 'RIGHT';
export type LayoutQuality = 'fast' | 'balanced' | 'quality';
export type EdgeRouting = 'ORTHOGONAL' | 'POLYLINE' | 'SPLINES';

interface LayoutOptions {
  direction?: LayoutDirection;
  quality?: LayoutQuality;
  edgeRouting?: EdgeRouting;
  nodeNodeSpacing?: number;
  layerSpacing?: number;
}

const qualityPresets: Record<LayoutQuality, Record<string, string>> = {
  fast: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'LAYER_SWEEP',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'SIMPLE',
  },
  balanced: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY_MODEL_ORDER',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'LONGEST_PATH',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'INTERACTIVE',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'LINEAR_SEGMENTS',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.strategy': 'EDGE_LENGTH',
  },
  quality: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY_MODEL_ORDER',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'COFFMAN_GRAHAM',
    'org.eclipse.elk.layered.layering.coffmanGraham.layerBound': '5',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'INTERACTIVE',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.sweep': 'ALL',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.networkSimplex.nodeFlexibility': 'true',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.bk.fixedAlignment': 'BALANCED',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.strategy': 'EDGE_LENGTH',
  },
};

const edgeRoutingMap: Record<EdgeRouting, string> = {
  'ORTHOGONAL': 'ORTHOGONAL',
  'POLYLINE': 'POLYLINE',
  'SPLINES': 'SPLINES',
};

export function useAutoLayout() {
  const autoLayout = useCallback(async (
    nodes: Node[],
    edges: Edge[],
    options: LayoutOptions = {}
  ): Promise<Node[]> => {
    if (nodes.length === 0) return nodes;

    const {
      direction = 'DOWN',
      quality = 'balanced',
      edgeRouting = 'ORTHOGONAL',
      nodeNodeSpacing = 60,
      layerSpacing = 100,
    } = options;

    const directionMap: Record<LayoutDirection, string> = {
      DOWN: 'DOWN',
      UP: 'UP',
      LEFT: 'LEFT',
      RIGHT: 'RIGHT',
    };

    // Получаем реальные размеры узлов из DOM
    const children = nodes.map(node => {
      const nodeElement = document.querySelector(`.react-flow__node[data-id="${node.id}"]`);
      let width = 180;
      let height = 70;
      
      if (nodeElement) {
        const rect = nodeElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        width = Math.max(rect.width, 150);
        height = Math.max(rect.height, 60);
      } else if (node.measured) {
        width = Math.max(node.measured.width || 180, 150);
        height = Math.max(node.measured.height || 70, 60);
      }
      
      return {
        id: node.id,
        width: width + 30,
        height: height + 20,
      };
    });

    const layoutOptions: Record<string, string> = {
      'elk.algorithm': 'layered',
      'elk.direction': directionMap[direction],
      'elk.spacing.nodeNode': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
      'elk.spacing.edgeNode': '40',
      'elk.spacing.edgeEdge': '20',
      'elk.layered.spacing.baseValue': String(layerSpacing),
      'elk.layered.spacing.nodeNodeBetweenLayers': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
      'elk.layered.mergeEdges': 'true',
      'elk.edgeRouting': edgeRoutingMap[edgeRouting],
      'elk.padding': '[top=60,left=60,bottom=60,right=60]',
      ...qualityPresets[quality],
    };

    if (edgeRouting === 'SPLINES') {
      layoutOptions['elk.edgeRouting.splines.mode'] = 'B_SPLINE';
    }

    const graph = {
      id: 'root',
      layoutOptions,
      children,
      edges: edges.map(edge => ({
        id: edge.id,
        sources: [edge.source],
        targets: [edge.target],
      })),
    };

    try {
      const laidOutGraph = await elk.layout(graph);
      
      const layoutedNodes = nodes.map(node => {
        const layoutNode = laidOutGraph.children?.find(n => n.id === node.id);
        if (layoutNode && layoutNode.x !== undefined && layoutNode.y !== undefined) {
          return {
            ...node,
            position: {
              x: Math.round(layoutNode.x),
              y: Math.round(layoutNode.y),
            },
          };
        }
        return node;
      });
      
      return layoutedNodes;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('ELK layout failed:', error);
      return nodes;
    }
  }, []);

  return { autoLayout };
}
```

3. **Добавил fallback позиций** - если ELK не справился, сохраняем текущие

## 2. Кастомный Layout — добавим отдельно

Создай новый файл: 
`tactical-command-v3/src/features/process-designer/hooks/useCustomLayout.ts`

```typescript
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Node, Edge } from '@xyflow/react';

interface CustomLayoutOptions {
  direction?: 'DOWN' | 'RIGHT';
  nodeSpacing?: number;
  layerSpacing?: number;
}

export function useCustomLayout() {
  const customLayout = useCallback(async (
    nodes: Node[],
    edges: Edge[],
    options: CustomLayoutOptions = {}
  ): Promise<Node[]> => {
    if (nodes.length === 0) return nodes;

    const {
      direction = 'DOWN',
      nodeSpacing = 100,
      layerSpacing = 150,
    } = options;

    // Строим граф зависимостей
    const adjacencyList = new Map<string, string[]>();
    const inDegree = new Map<string, number>();
    
    nodes.forEach(node => {
      adjacencyList.set(node.id, []);
      inDegree.set(node.id, 0);
    });
    
    edges.forEach(edge => {
      adjacencyList.get(edge.source)?.push(edge.target);
      inDegree.set(edge.target, (inDegree.get(edge.target) || 0) + 1);
    });
    
    // Топологическая сортировка
    const queue: string[] = [];
    const order: string[] = [];
    
    inDegree.forEach((degree, nodeId) => {
      if (degree === 0) queue.push(nodeId);
    });
    
    if (queue.length === 0 && nodes.length > 0) {
      queue.push(nodes[0].id);
    }
    
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const current = queue.shift()!;
      order.push(current);
      
      const neighbors = adjacencyList.get(current) || [];
      for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
        const newDegree = (inDegree.get(neighbor) || 0) - 1;
        inDegree.set(neighbor, newDegree);
        if (newDegree === 0) {
          queue.push(neighbor);
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Добавляем оставшиеся узлы (если есть циклы)
    if (order.length !== nodes.length) {
      nodes.forEach(node => {
        if (!order.includes(node.id)) order.push(node.id);
      });
    }
    
    // Рассчитываем позиции
    const layoutedNodes = nodes.map(node => {
      const index = order.indexOf(node.id);
      let x: number, y: number;
      
      if (direction === 'DOWN') {
        x = (index % 5) * nodeSpacing;
        y = Math.floor(index / 5) * layerSpacing;
      } else {
        x = Math.floor(index / 5) * layerSpacing;
        y = (index % 5) * nodeSpacing;
      }
      
      return {
        ...node,
        position: { x, y },
      };
    });
    
    return layoutedNodes;
  }, []);
  
  return { customLayout };
}
```

const handleAutoLayout = async () => {
  addTerminalLog(`[INFO] Running ${layoutEngine} layout (${layoutDirection}, ${layoutQuality}, ${edgeRouting})...`);
  
  if (nodes.length === 0) {
    addTerminalLog('[WARN] No nodes to layout');
    return;
  }
  
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  
  let layoutedNodes: Node[];
  
  if (layoutEngine === 'elk') {
    layoutedNodes = await autoLayout(nodes, edges, {
      direction: layoutDirection,
      quality: layoutQuality,
      edgeRouting: edgeRouting,
      nodeNodeSpacing: layoutQuality === 'fast' ? 60 : 80,
      layerSpacing: layoutQuality === 'fast' ? 100 : 140,
    });
  } else {
    // Кастомный layout
    const dir = layoutDirection === 'DOWN' || layoutDirection === 'UP' ? 'DOWN' : 'RIGHT';
    layoutedNodes = await customLayout(nodes, edges, {
      direction: dir,
      nodeSpacing: 100,
      layerSpacing: 150,
    });
  }
  
  setNodes(layoutedNodes);
  setTimeout(() => updateEdgesStyle(edgeRouting), 100);
  
  addTerminalLog('[OK] Layout completed');
};
```

  onStop={() => addTerminalLog('Stop pressed')}
  onSave={handleSave}
  onRun={handleExecute}
/>
```

## 🤖 **DeepSeek**

Отличное наблюдение! Это классическая проблема **иерархической компоновки**, когда ELKjs не различает семантику подключений (левый/правый хэндл — это "основной поток", а верхний/нижний — "ответвления").

## 🎯 Решение: Использование портов с весами (порядком)

В ELKjs можно задать **порядок (priority)** для портов, чтобы алгоритм знал, какие подключения важнее.

### Обновлённый `useAutoLayout.ts` с весами портов:

```typescript
// Функция для получения портов с весами
const getPortsForNode = (node: Node, quality: LayoutQuality) => {
  // Базовые порты с высоким приоритетом (основной поток)
  const highPriority = [
    { id: 'source-right', x: 1.0, y: 0.5, side: 'EAST', priority: 1 },
    { id: 'target-left', x: 0.0, y: 0.5, side: 'WEST', priority: 1 },
  ];
  
  // Средний приоритет (основные ответвления)
  const mediumPriority = [
    { id: 'source-bottom', x: 0.5, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH', priority: 2 },
    { id: 'target-top', x: 0.5, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH', priority: 2 },
  ];
  
  // Низкий приоритет (дополнительные ответвления)
  const lowPriority = [
    { id: 'source-right-2', x: 1.0, y: 0.3, side: 'EAST', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'source-right-3', x: 1.0, y: 0.7, side: 'EAST', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'target-left-2', x: 0.0, y: 0.3, side: 'WEST', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'target-left-3', x: 0.0, y: 0.7, side: 'WEST', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'source-bottom-2', x: 0.3, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'source-bottom-3', x: 0.7, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'target-top-2', x: 0.3, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'target-top-3', x: 0.7, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH', priority: 3 },
  ];
  
  if (quality === 'fast') {
    return highPriority;
  }
  if (quality === 'balanced') {
    return [...highPriority, ...mediumPriority];
  }
  // quality - все порты
  return [...highPriority, ...mediumPriority, ...lowPriority];
};
```

### Глобальная опция для "вертикального" и "горизонтального" разделения

Добавь в `layoutOptions` (в `autoLayout` функцию):

```typescript
const layoutOptions: Record<string, string> = {
  'elk.algorithm': 'layered',
  'elk.direction': directionMap[direction],
  'elk.spacing.nodeNode': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
  'elk.spacing.edgeNode': '40',
  'elk.spacing.edgeEdge': '20',
  'elk.layered.spacing.baseValue': String(layerSpacing),
  'elk.layered.spacing.nodeNodeBetweenLayers': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
  'elk.layered.mergeEdges': 'true',
  // ВАЖНО: Разделяем порты по типам
  'elk.layered.considerModelOrder.strategy': 'NODES_AND_EDGES',
  'elk.layered.feedbackEdges': 'true',
  'elk.edgeRouting': edgeRoutingMap[edgeRouting],
  'elk.padding': '[top=60,left=60,bottom=60,right=60]',
  ...qualityPresets[quality],
};
```

## 🚀 Альтернатива: Простой алгоритм на уровне React Flow

Если ELKjs не справляется, можно **насильно разводить узлы** после компоновки:

```typescript
// Добавь после setNodes в handleAutoLayout
const fixVerticalChildren = (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => {
  // Группируем узлы по родителям и портам подключения
  const childrenByParent: Map<string, Array<{ nodeId: string, port: string }>> = new Map();
  
  edges.forEach(edge => {
    if (!childrenByParent.has(edge.source)) {
      childrenByParent.set(edge.source, []);
    }
    childrenByParent.get(edge.source)!.push({
      nodeId: edge.target,
      port: edge.sourceHandle || 'source-right'
    });
  });
  
  // Корректируем позиции: узлы через нижний порт — выше, через левый/правый — по горизонтали
  childrenByParent.forEach((children, parentId) => {
    const parentNode = nodes.find(n => n.id === parentId);
    if (!parentNode) return;
    
    const topConnected = children.filter(c => c.port === 'source-bottom');
    const sideConnected = children.filter(c => c.port === 'source-right' || c.port === 'source-right-2');
    
    // Узлы через нижний порт должны быть выше и выровнены вертикально
    topConnected.forEach((child, idx) => {
      const childNode = nodes.find(n => n.id === child.nodeId);
      if (childNode) {
        childNode.position.x = parentNode.position.x + (idx - (topConnected.length - 1) / 2) * 150;
        childNode.position.y = parentNode.position.y - 200;
      }
    });
    
    // Узлы через правый порт — ниже и выровнены горизонтально
    sideConnected.forEach((child, idx) => {
      const childNode = nodes.find(n => n.id === child.nodeId);
      if (childNode) {
        childNode.position.x = parentNode.position.x + 250;
        childNode.position.y = parentNode.position.y + (idx - (sideConnected.length - 1) / 2) * 120;
      }
    });
  });
  
  return nodes;
};
```

   - `Process` узел — для основного потока (использует левый/правый порт)

## 🤖 **DeepSeek**

Вот полностью исправленный `useAutoLayout.ts` с приоритетами портов и улучшенной компоновкой:

```typescript
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import ELK from 'elkjs/lib/elk.bundled.js';
import type { Node, Edge } from '@xyflow/react';

const elk = new ELK();

export type LayoutDirection = 'DOWN' | 'UP' | 'LEFT' | 'RIGHT';
export type LayoutQuality = 'fast' | 'balanced' | 'quality';
export type EdgeRouting = 'ORTHOGONAL' | 'POLYLINE' | 'SPLINES';

interface LayoutOptions {
  direction?: LayoutDirection;
  quality?: LayoutQuality;
  edgeRouting?: EdgeRouting;
  nodeNodeSpacing?: number;
  layerSpacing?: number;
}

const qualityPresets: Record<LayoutQuality, Record<string, string>> = {
  fast: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'LAYER_SWEEP',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'SIMPLE',
  },
  balanced: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY_MODEL_ORDER',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'LONGEST_PATH',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'INTERACTIVE',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'LINEAR_SEGMENTS',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.strategy': 'EDGE_LENGTH',
  },
  quality: {
    'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY_MODEL_ORDER',
    'elk.layered.layering.strategy': 'COFFMAN_GRAHAM',
    'org.eclipse.elk.layered.layering.coffmanGraham.layerBound': '5',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.strategy': 'INTERACTIVE',
    'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.sweep': 'ALL',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.networkSimplex.nodeFlexibility': 'true',
    'elk.layered.nodePlacement.bk.fixedAlignment': 'BALANCED',
    'elk.layered.compaction.postCompaction.strategy': 'EDGE_LENGTH',
  },
};

const edgeRoutingMap: Record<EdgeRouting, string> = {
  'ORTHOGONAL': 'ORTHOGONAL',
  'POLYLINE': 'POLYLINE',
  'SPLINES': 'SPLINES',
};

// Функция для получения портов с приоритетами
const getPortsForNode = (node: Node, quality: LayoutQuality) => {
  const nodeType = node.data?.node_type || 'default';
  
  // Основной поток - высокий приоритет (слева-направо)
  const mainFlow = [
    { id: 'source-right', x: 1.0, y: 0.5, side: 'EAST', priority: 1 },
    { id: 'target-left', x: 0.0, y: 0.5, side: 'WEST', priority: 1 },
  ];
  
  // Вертикальные ответвления (низ/верх) - средний приоритет
  const verticalBranches = [
    { id: 'source-bottom', x: 0.5, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH', priority: 2 },
    { id: 'target-top', x: 0.5, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH', priority: 2 },
  ];
  
  // Дополнительные порты для quality режима
  const extraPorts = [
    { id: 'source-right-2', x: 1.0, y: 0.3, side: 'EAST', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'source-right-3', x: 1.0, y: 0.7, side: 'EAST', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'target-left-2', x: 0.0, y: 0.3, side: 'WEST', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'target-left-3', x: 0.0, y: 0.7, side: 'WEST', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'source-bottom-2', x: 0.3, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'source-bottom-3', x: 0.7, y: 1.0, side: 'SOUTH', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'target-top-2', x: 0.3, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH', priority: 3 },
    { id: 'target-top-3', x: 0.7, y: 0.0, side: 'NORTH', priority: 3 },
  ];
  
  // Для узлов типа decision/condition - больше вертикальных портов
  if (nodeType === 'decision' || nodeType === 'condition') {
    if (quality === 'fast') {
      return [...mainFlow, ...verticalBranches];
    }
    if (quality === 'balanced') {
      return [...mainFlow, ...verticalBranches, ...extraPorts.slice(0, 4)];
    }
    return [...mainFlow, ...verticalBranches, ...extraPorts];
  }
  
  // Стандартные узлы
  if (quality === 'fast') {
    return mainFlow;
  }
  if (quality === 'balanced') {
    return [...mainFlow, ...verticalBranches];
  }
  return [...mainFlow, ...verticalBranches, ...extraPorts];
};

export function useAutoLayout() {
  const autoLayout = useCallback(async (
    nodes: Node[],
    edges: Edge[],
    options: LayoutOptions = {}
  ): Promise<Node[]> => {
    if (nodes.length === 0) return nodes;

    const {
      direction = 'DOWN',
      quality = 'balanced',
      edgeRouting = 'ORTHOGONAL',
      nodeNodeSpacing = 80,
      layerSpacing = 120,
    } = options;

    const directionMap: Record<LayoutDirection, string> = {
      DOWN: 'DOWN',
      UP: 'UP',
      LEFT: 'LEFT',
      RIGHT: 'RIGHT',
    };

    // Получаем реальные размеры узлов из DOM
    const children = nodes.map(node => {
      const nodeElement = document.querySelector(`.react-flow__node[data-id="${node.id}"]`);
      let width = 180;
      let height = 70;
      
      if (nodeElement) {
        const rect = nodeElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        width = Math.max(rect.width, 150);
        height = Math.max(rect.height, 60);
      } else if (node.measured) {
        width = Math.max(node.measured.width || 180, 150);
        height = Math.max(node.measured.height || 70, 60);
      }
      
      return {
        id: node.id,
        width: width + 30,
        height: height + 20,
        ports: getPortsForNode(node, quality),
      };
    });

    // Обогащаем рёбра информацией о портах и приоритетах
    const enrichedEdges = edges.map(edge => {
      // Определяем приоритет ребра на основе порта
      let priority = 1;
      const sourceHandle = edge.sourceHandle || 'source-right';
      if (sourceHandle.includes('bottom') || sourceHandle.includes('top')) {
        priority = 2; // Вертикальные связи имеют меньший приоритет
      }
      
      return {
        id: edge.id,
        sources: [edge.source],
        targets: [edge.target],
        sourcePort: sourceHandle,
        targetPort: edge.targetHandle || 'target-left',
        priority: priority,
      };
    });

    const layoutOptions: Record<string, string> = {
      'elk.algorithm': 'layered',
      'elk.direction': directionMap[direction],
      'elk.spacing.nodeNode': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
      'elk.spacing.edgeNode': '50',
      'elk.spacing.edgeEdge': '30',
      'elk.layered.spacing.baseValue': String(layerSpacing),
      'elk.layered.spacing.nodeNodeBetweenLayers': String(nodeNodeSpacing),
      'elk.layered.mergeEdges': 'true',
      'elk.layered.mergeHierarchyEdges': 'true',
      // Учитываем приоритет рёбер
      'elk.layered.priority.edgePriority': 'true',
      'elk.layered.feedbackEdges': 'true',
      'elk.layered.cycleBreaking.strategy': 'GREEDY_MODEL_ORDER',
      'elk.edgeRouting': edgeRoutingMap[edgeRouting],
      'elk.padding': '[top=80,left=80,bottom=80,right=80]',
      ...qualityPresets[quality],
    };

    if (edgeRouting === 'SPLINES') {
      layoutOptions['elk.edgeRouting.splines.mode'] = 'B_SPLINE';
    }

    const graph = {
      id: 'root',
      layoutOptions,
      children,
      edges: enrichedEdges,
    };

    try {
      const laidOutGraph = await elk.layout(graph);
      
      const layoutedNodes = nodes.map(node => {
        const layoutNode = laidOutGraph.children?.find(n => n.id === node.id);
        if (layoutNode && layoutNode.x !== undefined && layoutNode.y !== undefined) {
          return {
            ...node,
            position: {
              x: Math.round(layoutNode.x),
              y: Math.round(layoutNode.y),
            },
          };
        }
        return node;
      });
      
      // Пост-обработка: корректируем позиции узлов, подключённых через вертикальные порты
      const adjustedNodes = adjustVerticalChildren(layoutedNodes, edges);
      
      return adjustedNodes;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('ELK layout failed:', error);
      return nodes;
    }
  }, []);

  // Пост-обработка: узлы через нижний/верхний порт должны быть выше/ниже родителя
  const adjustVerticalChildren = (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]): Node[] => {
    const nodesMap = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
    const verticalChildren: Map<string, string[]> = new Map();
    const horizontalChildren: Map<string, string[]> = new Map();
    
    // Группируем детей по типу подключения
    edges.forEach(edge => {
      const sourceHandle = edge.sourceHandle || 'source-right';
      const target = edge.target;
      
      if (sourceHandle.includes('bottom') || sourceHandle.includes('top')) {
        if (!verticalChildren.has(edge.source)) {
          verticalChildren.set(edge.source, []);
        }
        verticalChildren.get(edge.source)!.push(target);
      } else {
        if (!horizontalChildren.has(edge.source)) {
          horizontalChildren.set(edge.source, []);
        }
        horizontalChildren.get(edge.source)!.push(target);
      }
    });
    
    // Корректируем позиции
    const adjusted = nodes.map(node => {
      const originalPos = { ...node.position };
      let newY = originalPos.y;
      let newX = originalPos.x;
      
      // Узлы через вертикальные порты должны быть выше
      const vertChildren = verticalChildren.get(node.id) || [];
      if (vertChildren.length > 0) {
        vertChildren.forEach((childId, idx) => {
          const child = nodesMap.get(childId);
          if (child && child.position.y >= originalPos.y) {
            // Поднимаем вертикальных детей выше родителя
            newY = originalPos.y - 150 - (idx * 30);
          }
        });
      }
      
      // Узлы через горизонтальные порты остаются справа
      const horChildren = horizontalChildren.get(node.id) || [];
      if (horChildren.length > 0) {
        horChildren.forEach((childId, idx) => {
          const child = nodesMap.get(childId);
          if (child && child.position.x <= originalPos.x) {
            // Сдвигаем горизонтальных детей правее
            newX = originalPos.x + 200 + (idx * 20);
          }
        });
      }
      
      return {
        ...node,
        position: {
          x: newX,
          y: newY,
        },
      };
    });
    
    return adjusted;
  };

  return { autoLayout };
}
```

## Ключевые улучшения:

1. **Приоритеты портов** — основной поток (левый/правый) имеет приоритет 1, вертикальные ответвления — приоритет 2
2. **Учёт типа узла** — для узлов `decision`/`condition` больше вертикальных портов
3. **Приоритет рёбер** — в `layoutOptions` добавлено `elk.layered.priority.edgePriority: 'true'`
4. **Пост-обработка `adjustVerticalChildren`** — принудительно размещает узлы, подключённые через вертикальные порты, выше родителя
5. **Увеличенные отступы** — больше пространства для вертикальных веток

Теперь узлы, подключённые через **нижний/верхний порт**, должны располагаться **выше/ниже** родителя, а не в одной линии с горизонтальными подключениями.
