```tsx
  cellSize?: number;      // размер ячейки (ширина и высота)
  step?: number;          // минимальный шаг перемещения
}

// Квадратный узел
const CustomNode = ({ data }: any) => {
  const size = data.size || 80;
  
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        background: '#0A0F1A',
        border: `2px solid ${data.color || '#4A9FFF'}`,
        borderRadius: '6px',
        width: `${size}px`,
        height: `${size}px`,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        alignItems: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
        color: '#FFFFFF',
        fontSize: '11px',
        position: 'relative',
        textAlign: 'center',
        padding: '4px',
      }}
    >
      <Handle type="target" position={Position.Left} id="left" style={{ background: '#4A9FFF', width: 8, height: 8, left: -4 }} />
      <Handle type="source" position={Position.Right} id="right" style={{ background: '#4A9FFF', width: 8, height: 8, right: -4 }} />
      <Handle type="source" position={Position.Bottom} id="bottom" style={{ background: '#4A9FFF', width: 8, height: 8, bottom: -4 }} />
      <Handle type="target" position={Position.Top} id="top" style={{ background: '#4A9FFF', width: 8, height: 8, top: -4 }} />
      
      <div style={{ fontSize: '9px', color: '#8A9AB0', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
        {data.nodeType || 'NODE'}
      </div>
      {data.label}
    </div>
  );
};

const nodeTypes = {
  custom: CustomNode,
};

export function GridEditor({ 
  onSave, 
  cellSize = 80,
  step = 80
}: GridEditorProps) {
  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState([]);
  const [selectedNodeType, setSelectedNodeType] = useState('task');
  const [multiplier, setMultiplier] = useState(1);
  const reactFlowWrapper = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  
  // Текущий шаг сетки
  const currentStep = step * multiplier;

  const getNodeColor = (type: string): string => {
    const colors: Record<string, string> = {
      start: '#2DD4BF',
      end: '#EF4444',
      task: '#4A9FFF',
      condition: '#10B981',
      parallel: '#2DD4BF',
      join: '#4A9FFF',
      bash: '#4A9FFF',
      agent: '#8B5CF6',
    };
    return colors[type] || '#4A9FFF';
  };

  // Привязка к сетке
  const snapToGrid = (x: number, y: number) => {
    return {
      x: Math.round(x / currentStep) * currentStep,
      y: Math.round(y / currentStep) * currentStep
    };
  };

  const onPaneClick = useCallback(
    (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = reactFlowWrapper.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return;

      const rawX = event.clientX - rect.left;
      const rawY = event.clientY - rect.top;
      const { x, y } = snapToGrid(rawX, rawY);

      const newNode: Node = {
        id: `${Date.now()}`,
        type: 'custom',
        position: { x, y },
        data: {
          label: `${selectedNodeType.toUpperCase()}`,
          nodeType: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          color: getNodeColor(selectedNodeType),
          size: cellSize,
        },
      };
      setNodes((nds) => nds.concat(newNode));
    },
    [selectedNodeType, currentStep, setNodes, cellSize]
  );

  const onNodeDragStop = useCallback(
    (_event: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) => {
      const { x, y } = snapToGrid(node.position.x, node.position.y);
      setNodes((nds) =>
        nds.map((n) => (n.id === node.id ? { ...n, position: { x, y } } : n))
      );
    },
    [setNodes]
  );

  const onConnect = useCallback(
    (params: Connection) => {
      const newEdge = {
        ...params,
        id: `${params.source}-${params.target}-${Date.now()}`,
        animated: true,
        style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
        markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
      };
      setEdges((eds) => addEdge(newEdge, eds));
    },
    [setEdges]
  );

  const handleExport = () => {
    const exportData = {
      config: { cellSize, step, multiplier, currentStep },
      nodes: nodes.map((n) => ({
        id: n.id,
        position: n.position,
        data: n.data,
      })),
      edges: edges.map((e) => ({
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        sourceHandle: e.sourceHandle,
        targetHandle: e.targetHandle,
      })),
    };

    console.log('=== GRID EXPORT ===');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2));
    alert('Coordinates exported to console (F12)');
  };

  const clearGrid = () => {
    setNodes([]);
    setEdges([]);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '10px',
          background: '#1A2538',
          borderBottom: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          display: 'flex',
          gap: '10px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          alignItems: 'center',
          zIndex: 10,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: '12px' }}>
          Ячейка: {cellSize}×{cellSize}px | Шаг: {currentStep}px
        </span>

        <select
          value={selectedNodeType}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedNodeType(e.target.value)}
          style={{
            background: '#0A0F1A',
            color: '#FFFFFF',
            border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
            padding: '4px 8px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
          }}
        >
          <option value="start">START</option>
          <option value="end">END</option>
          <option value="task">TASK</option>
          <option value="condition">CONDITION</option>
          <option value="parallel">PARALLEL</option>
          <option value="join">JOIN</option>
          <option value="bash">BASH</option>
          <option value="agent">AGENT</option>
        </select>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Шаг ×</span>
          <select
            value={multiplier}
            onChange={(e) => setMultiplier(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value={0.5}>0.5 (половинный)</option>
            <option value={1}>1 (базовый)</option>
            <option value={1.5}>1.5 (полуторный)</option>
            <option value={2}>2 (двойной)</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={clearGrid}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#EF4444',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          Clear
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={handleExport}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#2DD4BF',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: '#0A0F1A',
          }}
        >
          Export JSON
        </button>

        <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
          🖱️ Click → add node
        </span>
      </div>

      <div ref={reactFlowWrapper} style={{ flex: 1, position: 'relative' }}>
        <ReactFlow
          nodes={nodes}
          edges={edges}
          onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
          onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
          onConnect={onConnect}
          onPaneClick={onPaneClick}
          onNodeDragStop={onNodeDragStop}
          nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
          fitView
          snapToGrid={true}
          snapGrid={[currentStep, currentStep]}
          defaultEdgeOptions={{
            animated: true,
            style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
            markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
          }}
        >
          <Background color="#2A3A50" gap={currentStep} size={1} variant="lines" />
          <Controls />
        </ReactFlow>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: '8px',
          background: '#0A0F1A',
          borderTop: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          fontSize: '11px',
          color: '#8A9AB0',
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        🎯 Узел = {cellSize}×{cellSize}px | Сетка = {currentStep}×{currentStep}px
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function GridEditorPage() {
  const handleSave = (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => {
    console.log('Saved:', nodes.length, 'nodes,', edges.length, 'edges');
  };

  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <GridEditor 
        onSave={handleSave} 
        cellSize={80}
        step={80}
      />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}
```

## Что теперь:

| Параметр | Значение |
|----------|----------|
| **Узел** | 80×80px (квадратный) |
| **Ячейка сетки** | 80×80px (совпадает с узлом) |
| **Множитель** | 0.5 → шаг 40px, 1 → 80px, 2 → 160px |
| **Привязка** | Узел становится РОВНО в ячейку |

**Сетка теперь точно совпадает с размером узла!** Узлы будут вставать ровно в ячейки.

---

## 👤 **Kirill**

Хэндлы должны иметь возвможность соединяться все - со всеми. Не нужно сейчас делить на типы узлов. Ты как раз потом отследишь и логику связей. 
Сделай ортогональные polilyne и возможность добавлять четныое количество хэндлов 4 8 16 (просто делением на равные части).
Возможность удалять узлы и откреплять связи

---

## 🤖 **DeepSeek**

Хорошо! Давай сделаем мощный грид-редактор с гибкими настройками.

## Полный `GridEditor.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  ReactFlow,
  ReactFlowProvider,
  Background,
  Controls,
  addEdge,
  useNodesState,
  useEdgesState,
  Position,
  Handle,
} from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Connection, Edge, Node } from '@xyflow/react';
import '@xyflow/react/dist/style.css';

interface GridEditorProps {
  onSave: (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => void;
  cellSize?: number;
  step?: number;
}

// Узел с динамическим количеством хэндлов
const CustomNode = ({ data, id }: any) => {
  const size = data.size || 80;
  const handlesCount = data.handlesCount || 4;
  
  // Генерация позиций для хэндлов по кругу
  const getHandlePositions = () => {
    const positions = [];
    const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / handlesCount;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < handlesCount; i++) {
      const angle = i * angleStep;
      // Вычисляем позицию на границе квадрата
      const cos = Math.cos(angle);
      const sin = Math.sin(angle);
      
      let left = '50%';
      let top = '50%';
      let position = Position.Right;
      
      if (Math.abs(cos) > Math.abs(sin)) {
        // Право или лево
        if (cos > 0) {
          left = '100%';
          position = Position.Right;
        } else {
          left = '0%';
          position = Position.Left;
        }
        top = `${50 + (sin / Math.abs(cos)) * 40}%`;
      } else {
        // Верх или низ
        if (sin > 0) {
          top = '100%';
          position = Position.Bottom;
        } else {
          top = '0%';
          position = Position.Top;
        }
        left = `${50 + (cos / Math.abs(sin)) * 40}%`;
      }
      
      positions.push({ id: `handle-${i}`, left, top, position });
    }
    return positions;
  };
  
  const handles = getHandlePositions();
  
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        background: '#0A0F1A',
        border: `2px solid ${data.color || '#4A9FFF'}`,
        borderRadius: '8px',
        width: `${size}px`,
        height: `${size}px`,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        alignItems: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
        color: '#FFFFFF',
        fontSize: '11px',
        position: 'relative',
        textAlign: 'center',
        padding: '4px',
        transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
      }}
      className="custom-node"
    >
      {handles.map((handle) => (
        <Handle
          key={handle.id}
          type="source"
          position={handle.position}
          id={handle.id}
          style={{
            background: '#4A9FFF',
            width: 6,
            height: 6,
            left: handle.left,
            top: handle.top,
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            position: 'absolute',
            cursor: 'crosshair',
          }}
        />
      ))}
      
      {/* Дополнительные target хэндлы для входящих связей */}
      {handles.map((handle) => (
        <Handle
          key={`target-${handle.id}`}
          type="target"
          position={handle.position}
          id={`target-${handle.id}`}
          style={{
            background: '#4A9FFF',
            width: 6,
            height: 6,
            left: handle.left,
            top: handle.top,
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            position: 'absolute',
            cursor: 'crosshair',
            opacity: 0.6,
          }}
        />
      ))}
      
      <div style={{ fontSize: '9px', color: '#8A9AB0', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
        {data.nodeType || 'NODE'}
      </div>
      {data.label}
      
      {/* Кнопка удаления */}
      <button
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          data.onDelete?.(id);
        }}
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: '-10px',
          right: '-10px',
          width: '20px',
          height: '20px',
          borderRadius: '50%',
          background: '#EF4444',
          border: 'none',
          color: 'white',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          fontSize: '12px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          opacity: 0,
          transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease',
        }}
        className="delete-btn"
      >
        ×
      </button>
      
      <style>{`
        .custom-node:hover .delete-btn {
          opacity: 1;
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

const nodeTypes = {
  custom: CustomNode,
};

export function GridEditor({ 
  onSave, 
  cellSize = 80,
  step = 80
}: GridEditorProps) {
  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState([]);
  const [selectedNodeType, setSelectedNodeType] = useState('task');
  const [multiplier, setMultiplier] = useState(1);
  const [handlesCount, setHandlesCount] = useState(4);
  const [edgeType, setEdgeType] = useState<'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep'>('step');
  const reactFlowWrapper = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  
  const currentStep = step * multiplier;

  const getNodeColor = (type: string): string => {
    const colors: Record<string, string> = {
      start: '#2DD4BF',
      end: '#EF4444',
      task: '#4A9FFF',
      condition: '#10B981',
      parallel: '#2DD4BF',
      join: '#4A9FFF',
      bash: '#4A9FFF',
      agent: '#8B5CF6',
    };
    return colors[type] || '#4A9FFF';
  };

  const snapToGrid = (x: number, y: number) => {
    return {
      x: Math.round(x / currentStep) * currentStep,
      y: Math.round(y / currentStep) * currentStep
    };
  };

  const onPaneClick = useCallback(
    (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = reactFlowWrapper.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return;

      const rawX = event.clientX - rect.left;
      const rawY = event.clientY - rect.top;
      const { x, y } = snapToGrid(rawX, rawY);

      const newNode: Node = {
        id: `${Date.now()}`,
        type: 'custom',
        position: { x, y },
        data: {
          label: `${selectedNodeType.toUpperCase()}`,
          nodeType: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          color: getNodeColor(selectedNodeType),
          size: cellSize,
          handlesCount: handlesCount,
          onDelete: (nodeId: string) => {
            setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => n.id !== nodeId));
            setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => e.source !== nodeId && e.target !== nodeId));
          },
        },
      };
      setNodes((nds) => nds.concat(newNode));
    },
    [selectedNodeType, currentStep, setNodes, cellSize, handlesCount]
  );

  const onNodeDragStop = useCallback(
    (_event: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) => {
      const { x, y } = snapToGrid(node.position.x, node.position.y);
      setNodes((nds) =>
        nds.map((n) => (n.id === node.id ? { ...n, position: { x, y } } : n))
      );
    },
    [setNodes]
  );

  const onConnect = useCallback(
    (params: Connection) => {
      const newEdge = {
        ...params,
        id: `${params.source}-${params.target}-${Date.now()}`,
        type: edgeType,
        animated: true,
        style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
        markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
      };
      setEdges((eds) => addEdge(newEdge, eds));
    },
    [setEdges, edgeType]
  );

  const handleExport = () => {
    const exportData = {
      config: { cellSize, step, multiplier, currentStep, handlesCount, edgeType },
      nodes: nodes.map((n) => ({
        id: n.id,
        position: n.position,
        data: { ...n.data, onDelete: undefined },
      })),
      edges: edges.map((e) => ({
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        sourceHandle: e.sourceHandle,
        targetHandle: e.targetHandle,
      })),
    };

    console.log('=== GRID EXPORT ===');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2));
    alert('Coordinates exported to console (F12)');
  };

  const clearGrid = () => {
    setNodes([]);
    setEdges([]);
  };

  const onEdgesDelete = useCallback((edgesToDelete: Edge[]) => {
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !edgesToDelete.includes(e)));
  }, [setEdges]);

  const onNodesDelete = useCallback((nodesToDelete: Node[]) => {
    const nodeIds = new Set(nodesToDelete.map((n) => n.id));
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => !nodeIds.has(n.id)));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !nodeIds.has(e.source) && !nodeIds.has(e.target)));
  }, [setNodes, setEdges]);

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '10px',
          background: '#1A2538',
          borderBottom: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          display: 'flex',
          gap: '10px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          alignItems: 'center',
          zIndex: 10,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: '12px' }}>
          Ячейка: {cellSize}×{cellSize}px | Шаг: {currentStep}px
        </span>

        <select
          value={selectedNodeType}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedNodeType(e.target.value)}
          style={{
            background: '#0A0F1A',
            color: '#FFFFFF',
            border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
            padding: '4px 8px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
          }}
        >
          <option value="start">START</option>
          <option value="end">END</option>
          <option value="task">TASK</option>
          <option value="condition">CONDITION</option>
          <option value="parallel">PARALLEL</option>
          <option value="join">JOIN</option>
          <option value="bash">BASH</option>
          <option value="agent">AGENT</option>
        </select>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Хэндлы</span>
          <select
            value={handlesCount}
            onChange={(e) => setHandlesCount(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value={4}>4</option>
            <option value={8}>8</option>
            <option value={16}>16</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Тип связи</span>
          <select
            value={edgeType}
            onChange={(e) => setEdgeType(e.target.value as any)}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value="straight">Straight</option>
            <option value="step">Orthogonal (Step)</option>
            <option value="smoothstep">Smooth Step</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Множитель</span>
          <select
            value={multiplier}
            onChange={(e) => setMultiplier(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value={0.5}>0.5 (половинный)</option>
            <option value={1}>1 (базовый)</option>
            <option value={1.5}>1.5 (полуторный)</option>
            <option value={2}>2 (двойной)</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={clearGrid}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#EF4444',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          Clear
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={handleExport}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#2DD4BF',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: '#0A0F1A',
          }}
        >
          Export JSON
        </button>

        <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
          🔗 Хэндлы соединяются все-со-всеми | 🗑️ Hover для удаления | Esc для отмены
        </span>
      </div>

      <div ref={reactFlowWrapper} style={{ flex: 1, position: 'relative' }}>
        <ReactFlow
          nodes={nodes}
          edges={edges}
          onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
          onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
          onConnect={onConnect}
          onPaneClick={onPaneClick}
          onNodeDragStop={onNodeDragStop}
          onEdgesDelete={onEdgesDelete}
          onNodesDelete={onNodesDelete}
          nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
          fitView
          snapToGrid={true}
          snapGrid={[currentStep, currentStep]}
          deleteKeyCode={['Delete', 'Backspace']}
          defaultEdgeOptions={{
            animated: true,
            style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
            markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
          }}
        >
          <Background color="#2A3A50" gap={currentStep} size={1} variant="lines" />
          <Controls />
        </ReactFlow>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: '8px',
          background: '#0A0F1A',
          borderTop: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          fontSize: '11px',
          color: '#8A9AB0',
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        🎯 Узел = {cellSize}×{cellSize}px | Сетка = {currentStep}×{currentStep}px | Хэндлов: {handlesCount}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function GridEditorPage() {
  const handleSave = (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => {
    console.log('Saved:', nodes.length, 'nodes,', edges.length, 'edges');
  };

  return (
```

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  ReactFlow,
  ReactFlowProvider,
  Background,
  Controls,
  addEdge,
  useNodesState,
  useEdgesState,
  Position,
  Handle,
} from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Connection, Edge, Node } from '@xyflow/react';
import '@xyflow/react/dist/style.css';

interface GridEditorProps {
  onSave: (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => void;
  cellSize?: number;
}

// Расчет позиций хэндлов по принципу subdivision
const getHandlePositions = (count: number) => {
  const positions: { id: string; left: string; top: string; position: Position; side: string }[] = [];
  
  // Количество хэндлов на сторону = count / 4
  const perSide = count / 4;
  if (perSide < 1) return positions;
  
  const sides = ['right', 'bottom', 'left', 'top'];
  const sidePositions: Record<string, Position> = {
    right: Position.Right,
    bottom: Position.Bottom,
    left: Position.Left,
    top: Position.Top,
  };
  
  sides.forEach((side) => {
    const steps = perSide;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      // Позиция от 0 до 1 на стороне
      let t = i / (steps - 1);
      if (steps === 1) t = 0.5;
      
      let left = '50%';
      let top = '50%';
      
      switch (side) {
        case 'right':
          left = '100%';
          top = `${t * 100}%`;
          break;
        case 'bottom':
          left = `${t * 100}%`;
          top = '100%';
          break;
        case 'left':
          left = '0%';
          top = `${t * 100}%';
          break;
        case 'top':
          left = `${t * 100}%`;
          top = '0%';
          break;
      }
      
      positions.push({
        id: `${side}-${i}`,
        left,
        top,
        position: sidePositions[side],
        side,
      });
    }
  });
  
  return positions;
};

// Квадратный узел
const CustomNode = ({ data, id }: any) => {
  const size = data.size || 80;
  const handlesCount = data.handlesCount || 4;
  const handles = getHandlePositions(handlesCount);
  
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        background: '#0A0F1A',
        border: `2px solid ${data.color || '#4A9FFF'}`,
        borderRadius: '8px',
        width: `${size}px`,
        height: `${size}px`,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        alignItems: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
        color: '#FFFFFF',
        fontSize: '11px',
        position: 'relative',
        textAlign: 'center',
        padding: '4px',
        transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
      }}
      className="custom-node"
    >
      {/* Source хэндлы */}
      {handles.map((handle) => (
        <Handle
          key={`source-${handle.id}`}
          type="source"
          position={handle.position}
          id={handle.id}
          style={{
            background: '#4A9FFF',
            width: 5,
            height: 5,
            left: handle.left,
            top: handle.top,
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            position: 'absolute',
            cursor: 'crosshair',
            zIndex: 10,
          }}
        />
      ))}
      
      {/* Target хэндлы (входящие) */}
      {handles.map((handle) => (
        <Handle
          key={`target-${handle.id}`}
          type="target"
          position={handle.position}
          id={`target-${handle.id}`}
          style={{
            background: '#4A9FFF',
            width: 5,
            height: 5,
            left: handle.left,
            top: handle.top,
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            position: 'absolute',
            cursor: 'crosshair',
            opacity: 0.5,
            zIndex: 10,
          }}
        />
      ))}
      
      <div style={{ fontSize: '9px', color: '#8A9AB0', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
        {data.nodeType || 'NODE'}
      </div>
      {data.label}
      
      <button
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          data.onDelete?.(id);
        }}
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: '-10px',
          right: '-10px',
          width: '20px',
          height: '20px',
          borderRadius: '50%',
          background: '#EF4444',
          border: 'none',
          color: 'white',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          fontSize: '12px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          opacity: 0,
          transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease',
          zIndex: 20,
        }}
        className="delete-btn"
      >
        ×
      </button>
      
      <style>{`
        .custom-node:hover .delete-btn {
          opacity: 1;
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

const nodeTypes = {
  custom: CustomNode,
};

export function GridEditor({ onSave, cellSize = 80 }: GridEditorProps) {
  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState([]);
  const [selectedNodeType, setSelectedNodeType] = useState('task');
  const [handlesCount, setHandlesCount] = useState(4);
  const [edgeType, setEdgeType] = useState<'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep'>('step');
  const reactFlowWrapper = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  
  // Минимальный шаг = половина ячейки
  const minStep = cellSize / 2;

  const getNodeColor = (type: string): string => {
    const colors: Record<string, string> = {
      start: '#2DD4BF',
      end: '#EF4444',
      task: '#4A9FFF',
      condition: '#10B981',
      parallel: '#2DD4BF',
      join: '#4A9FFF',
      bash: '#4A9FFF',
      agent: '#8B5CF6',
    };
    return colors[type] || '#4A9FFF';
  };

  // Привязка к минимальному шагу
  const snapToMinStep = (x: number, y: number) => {
    return {
      x: Math.round(x / minStep) * minStep,
      y: Math.round(y / minStep) * minStep
    };
  };

  const onPaneClick = useCallback(
    (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = reactFlowWrapper.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return;

      const rawX = event.clientX - rect.left;
      const rawY = event.clientY - rect.top;
      const { x, y } = snapToMinStep(rawX, rawY);

      const newNode: Node = {
        id: `${Date.now()}`,
        type: 'custom',
        position: { x, y },
        data: {
          label: `${selectedNodeType.toUpperCase()}`,
          nodeType: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          color: getNodeColor(selectedNodeType),
          size: cellSize,
          handlesCount: handlesCount,
          onDelete: (nodeId: string) => {
            setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => n.id !== nodeId));
            setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => e.source !== nodeId && e.target !== nodeId));
          },
        },
      };
      setNodes((nds) => nds.concat(newNode));
    },
    [selectedNodeType, setNodes, cellSize, handlesCount]
  );

  const onNodeDragStop = useCallback(
    (_event: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) => {
      const { x, y } = snapToMinStep(node.position.x, node.position.y);
      setNodes((nds) =>
        nds.map((n) => (n.id === node.id ? { ...n, position: { x, y } } : n))
      );
    },
    [setNodes]
  );

  const onConnect = useCallback(
    (params: Connection) => {
      const newEdge = {
        ...params,
        id: `${params.source}-${params.target}-${Date.now()}`,
        type: edgeType,
        animated: true,
        style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
        markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
      };
      setEdges((eds) => addEdge(newEdge, eds));
    },
    [setEdges, edgeType]
  );

  const handleExport = () => {
    const exportData = {
      config: { cellSize, minStep, handlesCount, edgeType },
      nodes: nodes.map((n) => ({
        id: n.id,
        position: n.position,
        data: { ...n.data, onDelete: undefined },
      })),
      edges: edges.map((e) => ({
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        sourceHandle: e.sourceHandle,
        targetHandle: e.targetHandle,
      })),
    };

    console.log('=== GRID EXPORT ===');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2));
    alert('Coordinates exported to console (F12)');
  };

  const clearGrid = () => {
    setNodes([]);
    setEdges([]);
  };

  const onEdgesDelete = useCallback((edgesToDelete: Edge[]) => {
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !edgesToDelete.includes(e)));
  }, [setEdges]);

  const onNodesDelete = useCallback((nodesToDelete: Node[]) => {
    const nodeIds = new Set(nodesToDelete.map((n) => n.id));
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => !nodeIds.has(n.id)));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !nodeIds.has(e.source) && !nodeIds.has(e.target)));
  }, [setNodes, setEdges]);

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '10px',
          background: '#1A2538',
          borderBottom: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          display: 'flex',
          gap: '10px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          alignItems: 'center',
          zIndex: 10,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: '12px' }}>
          Ячейка: {cellSize}×{cellSize}px | Шаг: {minStep}px
        </span>

        <select
          value={selectedNodeType}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedNodeType(e.target.value)}
          style={{
            background: '#0A0F1A',
            color: '#FFFFFF',
            border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
            padding: '4px 8px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
          }}
        >
          <option value="start">START</option>
          <option value="end">END</option>
          <option value="task">TASK</option>
          <option value="condition">CONDITION</option>
          <option value="parallel">PARALLEL</option>
          <option value="join">JOIN</option>
          <option value="bash">BASH</option>
          <option value="agent">AGENT</option>
        </select>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Хэндлы</span>
          <select
            value={handlesCount}
            onChange={(e) => setHandlesCount(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value={4}>4</option>
            <option value={8}>8</option>
            <option value={16}>16</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Тип связи</span>
          <select
            value={edgeType}
            onChange={(e) => setEdgeType(e.target.value as any)}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value="straight">Straight</option>
            <option value="step">Orthogonal (Step)</option>
            <option value="smoothstep">Smooth Step</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={clearGrid}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#EF4444',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          Clear
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={handleExport}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#2DD4BF',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: '#0A0F1A',
          }}
        >
          Export JSON
        </button>

        <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
          🔗 Все хэндлы соединяются со всеми | 🗑️ Hover для удаления | Del удалить связь
        </span>
      </div>

      <div ref={reactFlowWrapper} style={{ flex: 1, position: 'relative' }}>
        <ReactFlow
          nodes={nodes}
          edges={edges}
          onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
          onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
          onConnect={onConnect}
          onPaneClick={onPaneClick}
          onNodeDragStop={onNodeDragStop}
          onEdgesDelete={onEdgesDelete}
          onNodesDelete={onNodesDelete}
          nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
          fitView
          snapToGrid={true}
          snapGrid={[minStep, minStep]}
          deleteKeyCode={['Delete', 'Backspace']}
          defaultEdgeOptions={{
            animated: true,
            style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
            markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
          }}
        >
          <Background color="#2A3A50" gap={minStep} size={1} variant="lines" />
          <Controls />
        </ReactFlow>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: '8px',
          background: '#0A0F1A',
          borderTop: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          fontSize: '11px',
          color: '#8A9AB0',
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        🎯 Узел = {cellSize}×{cellSize}px | Шаг = {minStep}px (половина ячейки) | Хэндлов: {handlesCount}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function GridEditorPage() {
  const handleSave = (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => {
    console.log('Saved:', nodes.length, 'nodes,', edges.length, 'edges');
  };

  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <GridEditor 
        onSave={handleSave} 
        cellSize={80}
      />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}
```

| **Subdivision** | 4 → по 1 на сторону, 8 → по 2 на сторону, 16 → по 4 на сторону |
| **Типы связей** | Straight, Orthogonal, Smooth Step |

```tsx
      >
        ×
      </button>
      
      <style>{`
        .custom-node:hover .delete-btn {
          opacity: 1;
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

const nodeTypes = {
  custom: CustomNode,
};

export function GridEditor({ onSave, cellSize = 80 }: GridEditorProps) {
  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState([]);
  const [selectedNodeType, setSelectedNodeType] = useState('task');
  const [handlesCount, setHandlesCount] = useState(4);
  const [edgeType, setEdgeType] = useState<'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep'>('step');
  const reactFlowWrapper = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  
  const minStep = cellSize / 2;

  const getNodeColor = (type: string): string => {
    const colors: Record<string, string> = {
      start: '#2DD4BF',
      end: '#EF4444',
      task: '#4A9FFF',
      condition: '#10B981',
      parallel: '#2DD4BF',
      join: '#4A9FFF',
      bash: '#4A9FFF',
      agent: '#8B5CF6',
    };
    return colors[type] || '#4A9FFF';
  };

  const snapToMinStep = (x: number, y: number) => {
    return {
      x: Math.round(x / minStep) * minStep,
      y: Math.round(y / minStep) * minStep
    };
  };

  const onPaneClick = useCallback(
    (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = reactFlowWrapper.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return;

      const rawX = event.clientX - rect.left;
      const rawY = event.clientY - rect.top;
      const snapped = snapToMinStep(rawX, rawY);

      const newNode: Node = {
        id: String(Date.now()),
        type: 'custom',
        position: { x: snapped.x, y: snapped.y },
        data: {
          label: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          nodeType: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          color: getNodeColor(selectedNodeType),
          size: cellSize,
          handlesCount: handlesCount,
          onDelete: (nodeId: string) => {
            setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => n.id !== nodeId));
            setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => e.source !== nodeId && e.target !== nodeId));
          },
        },
      };
      setNodes((nds) => nds.concat(newNode));
    },
    [selectedNodeType, setNodes, cellSize, handlesCount]
  );

  const onNodeDragStop = useCallback(
    (event: any, node: Node) => {
      const snapped = snapToMinStep(node.position.x, node.position.y);
      setNodes((nds) =>
        nds.map((n) => (n.id === node.id ? { ...n, position: snapped } : n))
      );
    },
    [setNodes]
  );

  const onConnect = useCallback(
    (params: Connection) => {
      const newEdge = {
        ...params,
        id: params.source + '-' + params.target + '-' + Date.now(),
        type: edgeType,
        animated: true,
        style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
        markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
      };
      setEdges((eds) => addEdge(newEdge, eds));
    },
    [setEdges, edgeType]
  );

  const handleExport = () => {
    const exportData = {
      config: { cellSize: cellSize, minStep: minStep, handlesCount: handlesCount, edgeType: edgeType },
      nodes: nodes.map((n) => ({
        id: n.id,
        position: n.position,
        data: { ...n.data, onDelete: undefined },
      })),
      edges: edges.map((e) => ({
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        sourceHandle: e.sourceHandle,
        targetHandle: e.targetHandle,
      })),
    };

    console.log('=== GRID EXPORT ===');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2));
    alert('Coordinates exported to console (F12)');
  };

  const clearGrid = () => {
    setNodes([]);
    setEdges([]);
  };

  const onEdgesDelete = useCallback((edgesToDelete: Edge[]) => {
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !edgesToDelete.includes(e)));
  }, [setEdges]);

  const onNodesDelete = useCallback((nodesToDelete: Node[]) => {
    const nodeIds = new Set(nodesToDelete.map((n) => n.id));
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => !nodeIds.has(n.id)));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !nodeIds.has(e.source) && !nodeIds.has(e.target)));
  }, [setNodes, setEdges]);

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '10px',
          background: '#1A2538',
          borderBottom: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          display: 'flex',
          gap: '10px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          alignItems: 'center',
          zIndex: 10,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: '12px' }}>
          {'Ячейка: ' + cellSize + 'x' + cellSize + 'px | Шаг: ' + minStep + 'px'}
        </span>

        <select
          value={selectedNodeType}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedNodeType(e.target.value)}
          style={{
            background: '#0A0F1A',
            color: '#FFFFFF',
            border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
            padding: '4px 8px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
          }}
        >
          <option value="start">START</option>
          <option value="end">END</option>
          <option value="task">TASK</option>
          <option value="condition">CONDITION</option>
          <option value="parallel">PARALLEL</option>
          <option value="join">JOIN</option>
          <option value="bash">BASH</option>
          <option value="agent">AGENT</option>
        </select>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Хэндлы</span>
          <select
            value={handlesCount}
            onChange={(e) => setHandlesCount(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value={4}>4</option>
            <option value={8}>8</option>
            <option value={16}>16</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Тип связи</span>
          <select
            value={edgeType}
            onChange={(e) => setEdgeType(e.target.value as any)}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value="straight">Straight</option>
            <option value="step">Orthogonal (Step)</option>
            <option value="smoothstep">Smooth Step</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={clearGrid}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#EF4444',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          Clear
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={handleExport}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#2DD4BF',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: '#0A0F1A',
          }}
        >
          Export JSON
        </button>

        <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
          🔗 Все хэндлы соединяются со всеми | 🗑️ Hover для удаления | Del удалить связь
        </span>
      </div>

      <div ref={reactFlowWrapper} style={{ flex: 1, position: 'relative' }}>
        <ReactFlow
          nodes={nodes}
          edges={edges}
          onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
          onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
          onConnect={onConnect}
          onPaneClick={onPaneClick}
          onNodeDragStop={onNodeDragStop}
          onEdgesDelete={onEdgesDelete}
          onNodesDelete={onNodesDelete}
          nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
          fitView
          snapToGrid={true}
          snapGrid={[minStep, minStep]}
          deleteKeyCode={['Delete', 'Backspace']}
          defaultEdgeOptions={{
            animated: true,
            style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
            markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
          }}
        >
          <Background color="#2A3A50" gap={minStep} size={1} variant="lines" />
          <Controls />
        </ReactFlow>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: '8px',
          background: '#0A0F1A',
          borderTop: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          fontSize: '11px',
          color: '#8A9AB0',
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        {'🎯 Узел = ' + cellSize + 'x' + cellSize + 'px | Шаг = ' + minStep + 'px (половина ячейки) | Хэндлов: ' + handlesCount}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function GridEditorPage() {
  const handleSave = (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => {
    console.log('Saved:', nodes.length, 'nodes,', edges.length, 'edges');
  };

  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <GridEditor 
        onSave={handleSave} 
        cellSize={80}
      />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}
```

2. **Все строки с `${}` заменены** на конкатенацию через +
3. **Исправлены все возможные проблемы с синтаксисом**

## 🤖 **DeepSeek**

Отлично! Координаты собраны. Теперь я вижу логику:

## 📊 Анализ координат:

| Узел | X | Y | Относительно предыдущего |
|------|---|---|--------------------------|
| START | 120 | 320 | - |
| TASK | 240 | 320 | +120 |
| CONDITION | 360 | 320 | +120 |
| BASH | 480 | 200 | +120, Y-120 (вверх) |
| AGENT | 480 | 440 | +120, Y+120 (вниз) |
| JOIN | 600 | 320 | +120 |
| AGENT | 720 | 320 | +120 |
| PARALLEL | 840 | 320 | +120 |
| CONDITION | 960 | 80 | +120, Y-240 |
| TASK | 1080 | -40 | +120, Y-120 |
| BASH | 1080 | 200 | +0, Y+240 |
| BASH | 1080 | 320 | +0, Y+120 |
| AGENT | 1080 | 440 | +0, Y+120 |
| JOIN | 1200 | 320 | +120 |
| JOIN | 1200 | 80 | +0, Y-240 |
| JOIN | 1320 | 200 | +120, Y+120 |
| AGENT | 1440 | 200 | +120 |
| BASH | 1560 | 200 | +120 |
| END | 1680 | 200 | +120 |

## 🎯 Выявленная логика:

1. **Базовый шаг по X** = 120px (cellSize=80 + отступ 40)
2. **Базовый шаг по Y** = 120px
3. **Узлы через верхний порт** → Y = родитель.Y - 120
4. **Узлы через нижний порт** → Y = родитель.Y + 120
5. **Узлы через правый порт** → X = родитель.X + 120, Y = родитель.Y
6. **Condition (XOR)** → ветки вверх и вниз от того же X
7. **Parallel (AND)** → дочерние узлы по вертикали на одном X+120
8. **Join** → собирает ветки, усредняя Y

## ✅ Теперь могу написать точный алгоритм

Хочешь, я напишу `usePreciseLayout.ts` на основе этих правил? Он будет:

1. Анализировать `sourceHandle` (right/top/bottom/left)
2. Рассчитывать X = parent.X + 120 (для right)
3. Рассчитывать Y = parent.Y ± 120 (для top/bottom)
4. Для JOIN — усреднять Y всех входящих
5. Для CONDITION — веер на ±120
6. Для PARALLEL — вертикальный стек с шагом 120

**Какой минимальный шаг по X и Y ты хочешь использовать?**
- Из данных: 120px (что = cellSize 80 + 40)
- Множители: 0.5 → 40px, 1 → 80px, 1.5 → 120px, 2 → 160px

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  ReactFlow,
  ReactFlowProvider,
  Background,
  Controls,
  addEdge,
  useNodesState,
  useEdgesState,
  Position,
  Handle,
} from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Connection, Edge, Node } from '@xyflow/react';
import '@xyflow/react/dist/style.css';

interface GridEditorProps {
  onSave: (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => void;
  cellSize?: number;
}

// Расчет позиций хэндлов на основе subdivision
const getHandlePositions = (division: number) => {
  // division = 1 -> 4 хэндла (по одному на сторону)
  // division = 2 -> 8 хэндлов (по 2 на сторону)
  // division = 4 -> 16 хэндлов (по 4 на сторону)
  const perSide = division * 2;
  const positions: Array<{ id: string; left: string; top: string; position: Position; side: string }> = [];
  
  const sides = ['right', 'bottom', 'left', 'top'];
  const sidePositions: Record<string, Position> = {
    right: Position.Right,
    bottom: Position.Bottom,
    left: Position.Left,
    top: Position.Top,
  };
  
  sides.forEach((side) => {
    for (let i = 1; i <= perSide; i++) {
      // Позиция от 0 до 1 на стороне
      const t = i / (perSide + 1);
      
      let left = '50%';
      let top = '50%';
      
      if (side === 'right') {
        left = '100%';
        top = (t * 100) + '%';
      } else if (side === 'bottom') {
        left = (t * 100) + '%';
        top = '100%';
      } else if (side === 'left') {
        left = '0%';
        top = (t * 100) + '%';
      } else if (side === 'top') {
        left = (t * 100) + '%';
        top = '0%';
      }
      
      positions.push({
        id: side + '-' + i,
        left: left,
        top: top,
        position: sidePositions[side],
        side: side,
      });
    }
  });
  
  return positions;
};

// Квадратный узел
const CustomNode = ({ data, id }: any) => {
  const size = data.size || 80;
  const division = data.division || 1;
  const handles = getHandlePositions(division);
  
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        background: '#0A0F1A',
        border: '2px solid ' + (data.color || '#4A9FFF'),

        padding: '4px',

      }}
      className="custom-node"
    >
      {/* Source хэндлы (исходящие) */}
      {handles.map((handle) => (

};

export function GridEditor({ onSave, cellSize = 80 }: GridEditorProps) {
  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState([]);
  const [selectedNodeType, setSelectedNodeType] = useState('task');
  const [division, setDivision] = useState(1); // 1 -> 4 хэндла, 2 -> 8, 4 -> 16
  const [edgeType, setEdgeType] = useState<'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep'>('step');
  const reactFlowWrapper = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  
  const minStep = cellSize / 2;

  const getNodeColor = (type: string): string => {
    const colors: Record<string, string> = {
      start: '#2DD4BF',
      end: '#EF4444',
      task: '#4A9FFF',
      condition: '#10B981',
      parallel: '#2DD4BF',
      join: '#4A9FFF',
      bash: '#4A9FFF',
      agent: '#8B5CF6',
    };
    return colors[type] || '#4A9FFF';
  };

  const snapToMinStep = (x: number, y: number) => {
    return {
      x: Math.round(x / minStep) * minStep,
      y: Math.round(y / minStep) * minStep
    };
  };

  const onPaneClick = useCallback(
    (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = reactFlowWrapper.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return;

      const rawX = event.clientX - rect.left;
      const rawY = event.clientY - rect.top;
      const snapped = snapToMinStep(rawX, rawY);

      const newNode: Node = {
        id: String(Date.now()),
        type: 'custom',
        position: { x: snapped.x, y: snapped.y },
        data: {
          label: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          nodeType: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          color: getNodeColor(selectedNodeType),
          size: cellSize,
          division: division,
          onDelete: (nodeId: string) => {
            setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => n.id !== nodeId));
            setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => e.source !== nodeId && e.target !== nodeId));
          },
        },
      };
      setNodes((nds) => nds.concat(newNode));
    },
    [selectedNodeType, setNodes, cellSize, division]
  );

  const onNodeDragStop = useCallback(
    (event: any, node: Node) => {
      const snapped = snapToMinStep(node.position.x, node.position.y);
      setNodes((nds) =>
        nds.map((n) => (n.id === node.id ? { ...n, position: snapped } : n))
      );
    },
    [setNodes]
  );

  // Сохраняем направление связи на основе захваченного хэндла
  const onConnect = useCallback(
    (params: Connection) => {
      console.log('Connection:', params);
      
      const newEdge = {
        ...params,
        id: params.source + '-' + params.target + '-' + Date.now(),
        type: edgeType,
        animated: true,
        style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
        markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
      };
      setEdges((eds) => addEdge(newEdge, eds));
    },
    [setEdges, edgeType]
  );

  const handleExport = () => {
    const exportData = {
      config: { cellSize: cellSize, minStep: minStep, division: division, edgeType: edgeType },
      nodes: nodes.map((n) => ({
        id: n.id,
        position: n.position,
        data: { ...n.data, onDelete: undefined },
      })),
      edges: edges.map((e) => ({
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        sourceHandle: e.sourceHandle,
        targetHandle: e.targetHandle,
      })),
    };

    console.log('=== GRID EXPORT ===');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2));
    alert('Coordinates exported to console (F12)');
  };

  const clearGrid = () => {
    setNodes([]);
    setEdges([]);
  };

  const onEdgesDelete = useCallback((edgesToDelete: Edge[]) => {
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !edgesToDelete.includes(e)));
  }, [setEdges]);

  const onNodesDelete = useCallback((nodesToDelete: Node[]) => {
    const nodeIds = new Set(nodesToDelete.map((n) => n.id));
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => !nodeIds.has(n.id)));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !nodeIds.has(e.source) && !nodeIds.has(e.target)));
  }, [setNodes, setEdges]);

  // Получение количества хэндлов для отображения
  const getHandlesCount = () => {
    return division * 4;
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '10px',
          background: '#1A2538',
          borderBottom: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          display: 'flex',
          gap: '10px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          alignItems: 'center',
          zIndex: 10,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: '12px' }}>
          {'Ячейка: ' + cellSize + 'x' + cellSize + 'px | Шаг: ' + minStep + 'px'}
        </span>

        <select
          value={selectedNodeType}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedNodeType(e.target.value)}
          style={{
            background: '#0A0F1A',
            color: '#FFFFFF',
            border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
            padding: '4px 8px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
          }}
        >
          <option value="start">START</option>
          <option value="end">END</option>
          <option value="task">TASK</option>
          <option value="condition">CONDITION</option>
          <option value="parallel">PARALLEL</option>
          <option value="join">JOIN</option>
          <option value="bash">BASH</option>
          <option value="agent">AGENT</option>
        </select>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Деление</span>
          <select
            value={division}
            onChange={(e) => setDivision(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value={1}>1 (4 хэндла)</option>
            <option value={2}>2 (8 хэндлов)</option>
            <option value={4}>4 (16 хэндлов)</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Тип связи</span>
          <select
            value={edgeType}
            onChange={(e) => setEdgeType(e.target.value as any)}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value="straight">Straight</option>
            <option value="step">Orthogonal (Step)</option>
            <option value="smoothstep">Smooth Step</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={clearGrid}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#EF4444',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          Clear
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={handleExport}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',

          }}
        >
          Export JSON
        </button>

        <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
          {'🔗 Хэндлов: ' + getHandlesCount() + ' | 🗑️ Hover для удаления | Del удалить связь'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div ref={reactFlowWrapper} style={{ flex: 1, position: 'relative' }}>
        <ReactFlow
          nodes={nodes}
          edges={edges}
          onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
          onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
          onConnect={onConnect}
          onPaneClick={onPaneClick}
          onNodeDragStop={onNodeDragStop}
          onEdgesDelete={onEdgesDelete}
          onNodesDelete={onNodesDelete}
          nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
          fitView
          snapToGrid={true}
          snapGrid={[minStep, minStep]}
          deleteKeyCode={['Delete', 'Backspace']}
          defaultEdgeOptions={{
            animated: true,

        >
```

### Subdivision логика:
- **division = 1** → по 2 хэндла на сторону → 8 хэндлов
- **division = 2** → по 4 хэндла на сторону → 16 хэндлов  
- **division = 4** → по 8 хэндлов на сторону → 32 хэндла

### Формула:
```
perSide = division * 2
handlesCount = perSide * 4 = division * 8
```

### Направление связей:
- При перетаскивании из хэндла запоминается `sourceHandle`
- При соединении сохраняется и `sourceHandle` и `targetHandle`
- Стрелка показывает направление от source к target

## 🤖 **DeepSeek**

## Правильная логика subdivision:

**При division = 1** (делим каждую сторону на 1 отрезок):
- Каждая сторона имеет 2 конца + 1 деление посередине = **3 точки на сторону**
- Или я ошибаюсь? Давай разберем:

### Blender subdivision логика для квадрата:

**Уровень 0 (без деления):** 4 хэндла (по углам? или по серединам сторон?)

В BPMN стандарт: хэндлы находятся по **серединам сторон** (не по углам).

Тогда:
- **Division 1 (1 сегмент на сторону):** 1 хэндл посередине → **4 хэндла**
- **Division 2 (2 сегмента на сторону):** 2 хэндла (в точках 1/3 и 2/3) → **8 хэндлов**
- **Division 4 (4 сегмента на сторону):** 4 хэндла (в точках 1/5, 2/5, 3/5, 4/5) → **16 хэндлов**

### Формула:
```
handlesPerSide = division * 2
handlesCount = handlesPerSide * 4
```

При division=1: `2 * 4 = 8` — это 8 хэндлов (по 2 на сторону, не считая углов)

Но для BPMN нужно **по середине стороны**:

## Исправленная функция `getHandlePositions`:

```typescript
const getHandlePositions = (division: number) => {
  // division = 1 -> 4 хэндла (по одному на сторону, посередине)
  // division = 2 -> 8 хэндлов (по два на сторону: в 1/3 и 2/3)
  // division = 4 -> 16 хэндлов (по четыре на сторону)
  
  const perSide = division * 2;
  const positions = [];
  
  const sides = ['right', 'bottom', 'left', 'top'];
  const sidePositions = {
    right: Position.Right,
    bottom: Position.Bottom,
    left: Position.Left,
    top: Position.Top,
  };
  
  sides.forEach((side) => {
    // Количество хэндлов на этой стороне = division * 2
    const count = division * 2;
    
    for (let i = 1; i <= count; i++) {
      // Позиция от 0 до 1: i/(count+1)
      // Например, при count=2: 1/3=0.33, 2/3=0.66
      // При count=4: 1/5=0.2, 2/5=0.4, 3/5=0.6, 4/5=0.8
      const t = i / (count + 1);
      
      let left = '50%';
      let top = '50%';
      
      if (side === 'right') {
        left = '100%';
        top = (t * 100) + '%';
      } else if (side === 'bottom') {
        left = (t * 100) + '%';
        top = '100%';
      } else if (side === 'left') {
        left = '0%';
        top = (t * 100) + '%';
      } else if (side === 'top') {
        left = (t * 100) + '%';
        top = '0%';
      }
      
      positions.push({
        id: side + '-' + i,
        left: left,
        top: top,
        position: sidePositions[side],
        side: side,
      });
    }
  });
  
  return positions;
};
```

| division | perSide | Всего хэндлов | Позиции на стороне |
|----------|---------|---------------|-------------------|
| 1 | 2 | 8 | 1/3, 2/3 |
| 2 | 4 | 16 | 1/5, 2/5, 3/5, 4/5 |
| 4 | 8 | 32 | 1/9, 2/9, 3/9, 4/9, 5/9, 6/9, 7/9, 8/9 |

## 🤖 **DeepSeek**

## Правильная логика subdivision:

```
Уровень 0 (division = 0): 0 хэндлов (только углы)
Уровень 1 (division = 1): 1 хэндл (середина стороны) → 1 сегмент
Уровень 2 (division = 2): добавляем середины новых отрезков → 3 хэндла
Уровень 3 (division = 3): добавляем середины еще → 7 хэндлов
Уровень 4 (division = 4): → 15 хэндлов
```

**Формула:** `handlesPerSide = (2^division) - 1`

| division | handlesPerSide | Всего хэндлов |
|----------|---------------|---------------|
| 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 | 4 |
| 2 | 3 | 12 |
| 3 | 7 | 28 |
| 4 | 15 | 60 |

```typescript
const getHandlePositions = (division: number) => {
  // division = 1 -> 1 хэндл посередине (позиция 0.5)
  // division = 2 -> 3 хэндла (0.25, 0.5, 0.75)
  // division = 3 -> 7 хэндлов (0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.625, 0.75, 0.875)
  
  if (division === 0) return [];
  
  const handlesPerSide = Math.pow(2, division) - 1;
  const positions = [];
  
  const sides = ['right', 'bottom', 'left', 'top'];
  const sidePositions = {
    right: Position.Right,
    bottom: Position.Bottom,
    left: Position.Left,
    top: Position.Top,
  };
  
  sides.forEach((side) => {
    for (let i = 1; i <= handlesPerSide; i++) {
      // Позиция от 0 до 1: i / (handlesPerSide + 1)
      const t = i / (handlesPerSide + 1);
      
      let left = '50%';
      let top = '50%';
      
      if (side === 'right') {
        left = '100%';
        top = (t * 100) + '%';
      } else if (side === 'bottom') {
        left = (t * 100) + '%';
        top = '100%';
      } else if (side === 'left') {
        left = '0%';
        top = (t * 100) + '%';
      } else if (side === 'top') {
        left = (t * 100) + '%';
        top = '0%';
      }
      
      positions.push({
        id: side + '-' + i,
        left: left,
        top: top,
        position: sidePositions[side],
        side: side,
      });
    }
  });
  
  return positions;
};
```

## Полностью исправленный `GridEditor.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  ReactFlow,
  ReactFlowProvider,
  Background,
  Controls,
  addEdge,
  useNodesState,
  useEdgesState,
  Position,
  Handle,
} from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Connection, Edge, Node } from '@xyflow/react';
import '@xyflow/react/dist/style.css';

interface GridEditorProps {
  onSave: (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => void;
  cellSize?: number;
}

// Расчет позиций хэндлов на основе рекурсивного деления (как в Blender)
const getHandlePositions = (division: number) => {
  // division = 1 -> 1 хэндл посередине (позиция 0.5)
  // division = 2 -> 3 хэндла (0.25, 0.5, 0.75)
  // division = 3 -> 7 хэндлов (0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.625, 0.75, 0.875)
  // division = 4 -> 15 хэндлов
  
  if (division === 0) return [];
  
  const handlesPerSide = Math.pow(2, division) - 1;
  const positions: Array<{ id: string; left: string; top: string; position: Position; side: string }> = [];
  
  const sides = ['right', 'bottom', 'left', 'top'];
  const sidePositions: Record<string, Position> = {
    right: Position.Right,
    bottom: Position.Bottom,
    left: Position.Left,
    top: Position.Top,
  };
  
  sides.forEach((side) => {
    for (let i = 1; i <= handlesPerSide; i++) {
      // Позиция от 0 до 1: i / (handlesPerSide + 1)
      const t = i / (handlesPerSide + 1);
      
      let left = '50%';
      let top = '50%';
      
      if (side === 'right') {
        left = '100%';
        top = (t * 100) + '%';
      } else if (side === 'bottom') {
        left = (t * 100) + '%';
        top = '100%';
      } else if (side === 'left') {
        left = '0%';
        top = (t * 100) + '%';
      } else if (side === 'top') {
        left = (t * 100) + '%';
        top = '0%';
      }
      
      positions.push({
        id: side + '-' + i,
        left: left,
        top: top,
        position: sidePositions[side],
        side: side,
      });
    }
  });
  
  return positions;
};

// Квадратный узел
const CustomNode = ({ data, id }: any) => {
  const size = data.size || 80;
  const division = data.division || 1;
  const handles = getHandlePositions(division);
  
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        background: '#0A0F1A',
        border: '2px solid ' + (data.color || '#4A9FFF'),
        borderRadius: '8px',
        width: size + 'px',
        height: size + 'px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        alignItems: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
        color: '#FFFFFF',
        fontSize: '11px',
        position: 'relative',
        textAlign: 'center',
        padding: '4px',
        transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
      }}
      className="custom-node"
    >
      {/* Source хэндлы (исходящие) */}
      {handles.map((handle) => (
        <Handle
          key={'source-' + handle.id}
          type="source"
          position={handle.position}
          id={handle.id}
          style={{
            background: '#4A9FFF',
            width: 6,
            height: 6,
            left: handle.left,
            top: handle.top,
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            position: 'absolute',
            cursor: 'crosshair',
            zIndex: 10,
          }}
        />
      ))}
      
      {/* Target хэндлы (входящие) */}
      {handles.map((handle) => (
        <Handle
          key={'target-' + handle.id}
          type="target"
          position={handle.position}
          id={'target-' + handle.id}
          style={{
            background: '#4A9FFF',
            width: 6,
            height: 6,
            left: handle.left,
            top: handle.top,
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            position: 'absolute',
            cursor: 'crosshair',
            opacity: 0.6,
            zIndex: 10,
          }}
        />
      ))}
      
      <div style={{ fontSize: '9px', color: '#8A9AB0', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
        {data.nodeType || 'NODE'}
      </div>
      {data.label}
      
      <button
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          data.onDelete(id);
        }}
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: '-10px',
          right: '-10px',
          width: '20px',
          height: '20px',
          borderRadius: '50%',
          background: '#EF4444',
          border: 'none',
          color: 'white',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          fontSize: '12px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          opacity: 0,
          transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease',
          zIndex: 20,
        }}
        className="delete-btn"
      >
        ×
      </button>
      
      <style>{`
        .custom-node:hover .delete-btn {
          opacity: 1;
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

const nodeTypes = {
  custom: CustomNode,
};

export function GridEditor({ onSave, cellSize = 80 }: GridEditorProps) {
  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState([]);
  const [selectedNodeType, setSelectedNodeType] = useState('task');
  const [division, setDivision] = useState(1);
  const [edgeType, setEdgeType] = useState<'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep'>('step');
  const reactFlowWrapper = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  
  const minStep = cellSize / 2;

  const getNodeColor = (type: string): string => {
    const colors: Record<string, string> = {
      start: '#2DD4BF',
      end: '#EF4444',
      task: '#4A9FFF',
      condition: '#10B981',
      parallel: '#2DD4BF',
      join: '#4A9FFF',
      bash: '#4A9FFF',
      agent: '#8B5CF6',
    };
    return colors[type] || '#4A9FFF';
  };

  const getHandlesCount = () => {
    if (division === 0) return 0;
    return Math.pow(2, division) * 4 - 4;
  };

  const snapToMinStep = (x: number, y: number) => {
    return {
      x: Math.round(x / minStep) * minStep,
      y: Math.round(y / minStep) * minStep
    };
  };

  const onPaneClick = useCallback(
    (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = reactFlowWrapper.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return;

      const rawX = event.clientX - rect.left;
      const rawY = event.clientY - rect.top;
      const snapped = snapToMinStep(rawX, rawY);

      const newNode: Node = {
        id: String(Date.now()),
        type: 'custom',
        position: { x: snapped.x, y: snapped.y },
        data: {
          label: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          nodeType: selectedNodeType.toUpperCase(),
          color: getNodeColor(selectedNodeType),
          size: cellSize,
          division: division,
          onDelete: (nodeId: string) => {
            setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => n.id !== nodeId));
            setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => e.source !== nodeId && e.target !== nodeId));
          },
        },
      };
      setNodes((nds) => nds.concat(newNode));
    },
    [selectedNodeType, setNodes, cellSize, division]
  );

  const onNodeDragStop = useCallback(
    (event: any, node: Node) => {
      const snapped = snapToMinStep(node.position.x, node.position.y);
      setNodes((nds) =>
        nds.map((n) => (n.id === node.id ? { ...n, position: snapped } : n))
      );
    },
    [setNodes]
  );

  const onConnect = useCallback(
    (params: Connection) => {
      console.log('Connection:', params.sourceHandle, '->', params.targetHandle);
      
      const newEdge = {
        ...params,
        id: params.source + '-' + params.target + '-' + Date.now(),
        type: edgeType,
        animated: true,
        style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
        markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
      };
      setEdges((eds) => addEdge(newEdge, eds));
    },
    [setEdges, edgeType]
  );

  const handleExport = () => {
    const exportData = {
      config: { 
        cellSize: cellSize, 
        minStep: minStep, 
        division: division, 
        handlesCount: getHandlesCount(),
        edgeType: edgeType 
      },
      nodes: nodes.map((n) => ({
        id: n.id,
        position: n.position,
        data: { ...n.data, onDelete: undefined },
      })),
      edges: edges.map((e) => ({
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        sourceHandle: e.sourceHandle,
        targetHandle: e.targetHandle,
      })),
    };

    console.log('=== GRID EXPORT ===');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2));
    alert('Coordinates exported to console (F12)');
  };

  const clearGrid = () => {
    setNodes([]);
    setEdges([]);
  };

  const onEdgesDelete = useCallback((edgesToDelete: Edge[]) => {
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !edgesToDelete.includes(e)));
  }, [setEdges]);

  const onNodesDelete = useCallback((nodesToDelete: Node[]) => {
    const nodeIds = new Set(nodesToDelete.map((n) => n.id));
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => !nodeIds.has(n.id)));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => !nodeIds.has(e.source) && !nodeIds.has(e.target)));
  }, [setNodes, setEdges]);

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '10px',
          background: '#1A2538',
          borderBottom: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          display: 'flex',
          gap: '10px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          alignItems: 'center',
          zIndex: 10,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: '12px' }}>
          {'Ячейка: ' + cellSize + 'x' + cellSize + 'px | Шаг: ' + minStep + 'px'}
        </span>

        <select
          value={selectedNodeType}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedNodeType(e.target.value)}
          style={{
            background: '#0A0F1A',
            color: '#FFFFFF',
            border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
            padding: '4px 8px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
          }}
        >
          <option value="start">START</option>
          <option value="end">END</option>
          <option value="task">TASK</option>
          <option value="condition">CONDITION</option>
          <option value="parallel">PARALLEL</option>
          <option value="join">JOIN</option>
          <option value="bash">BASH</option>
          <option value="agent">AGENT</option>
        </select>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Subdivision</span>
          <select
            value={division}
            onChange={(e) => setDivision(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value={1}>1 (4 хэндла)</option>
            <option value={2}>2 (12 хэндлов)</option>
            <option value={3}>3 (28 хэндлов)</option>
            <option value={4}>4 (60 хэндлов)</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px' }}>Тип связи</span>
          <select
            value={edgeType}
            onChange={(e) => setEdgeType(e.target.value as any)}
            style={{
              background: '#0A0F1A',
              color: '#FFFFFF',
              border: '1px solid #4A9FFF',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
          >
            <option value="straight">Straight</option>
            <option value="step">Orthogonal (Step)</option>
            <option value="smoothstep">Smooth Step</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={clearGrid}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#EF4444',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          Clear
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={handleExport}
          style={{
            padding: '4px 12px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: '#2DD4BF',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            color: '#0A0F1A',
          }}
        >
          Export JSON
        </button>

        <span style={{ color: '#8A9AB0', fontSize: '11px', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
          {'🔗 Хэндлов: ' + getHandlesCount() + ' | 🗑️ Hover удалить узел | Del удалить связь'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div ref={reactFlowWrapper} style={{ flex: 1, position: 'relative' }}>
        <ReactFlow
          nodes={nodes}
          edges={edges}
          onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
          onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
          onConnect={onConnect}
          onPaneClick={onPaneClick}
          onNodeDragStop={onNodeDragStop}
          onEdgesDelete={onEdgesDelete}
          onNodesDelete={onNodesDelete}
          nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
          fitView
          snapToGrid={true}
          snapGrid={[minStep, minStep]}
          deleteKeyCode={['Delete', 'Backspace']}
          defaultEdgeOptions={{
            animated: true,
            style: { stroke: '#4A9FFF', strokeWidth: 2 },
            markerEnd: { type: 'arrowclosed', color: '#4A9FFF' },
          }}
        >
          <Background color="#2A3A50" gap={minStep} size={1} variant="lines" />
          <Controls />
        </ReactFlow>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: '8px',
          background: '#0A0F1A',
          borderTop: '1px solid #2A3A50',
          fontSize: '11px',
          color: '#8A9AB0',
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        {'🎯 Узел = ' + cellSize + 'x' + cellSize + 'px | Шаг = ' + minStep + 'px | Subdivision: ' + division + ' → ' + getHandlesCount() + ' хэндлов'}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function GridEditorPage() {
  const handleSave = (nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[]) => {
    console.log('Saved:', nodes.length, 'nodes,', edges.length, 'edges');
  };

  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <GridEditor 
        onSave={handleSave} 
        cellSize={80}
      />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}
```

## Ключевые исправления:

1. **Subdivision логика** — рекурсивное деление отрезка пополам:
   - division=1 → 4 хэндла (по 1 на сторону)
   - division=2 → 12 хэндлов (по 3 на сторону)
   - division=3 → 28 хэндлов (по 7 на сторону)
   - division=4 → 60 хэндлов (по 15 на сторону)

2. **Формула:** `handlesPerSide = (2^division) - 1`

3. **Позиции хэндлов:** `t = i / (handlesPerSide + 1)` — дает равномерное распределение

4. **Направление связей** — сохраняется `sourceHandle` и `targetHandle`
